Once there was a big bear named Bob. Bob loved to hug his friends. He hugged the trees, the birds, and even the sun! But one day, Bob saw a little bunny named Ben. Bob wanted to hug Ben too. He ran to Ben and gave him a big bear hug! Ben felt squished and said, “Ouch! I love hugs, but not so tight!”   Bob felt sad. He did not want to hurt Ben. So, he learned to give soft hugs. Now, Bob hugs his friends gently, and everyone is happy. They play and laugh together, and Bob loves to see his friends smile!

Once, a little boy named Tim had a big idea. He saw a bird fly high in the sky and wanted to make a kite. Tim found a big piece of paper and some sticks. He used string to tie them all together.   With his kite ready, Tim ran fast. The kite flew up, up, up! Tim laughed and danced. He felt happy and free, just like the bird. Tim knew he could make good things when he used his mind and heart.

Once there was a big, happy dog named Ben. Ben loved to run and play with his friend, a small boy named Tim. They would chase balls and jump in the grass. One day, they found a big, red ball. Ben and Tim were so happy! But, oh no! The ball rolled into a big, deep hole. Ben barked and Tim cried. They could not get the ball back.   But then, Ben had a smart idea! He ran to get a long stick. Tim used the stick to reach the ball. They pulled it out! Ben and Tim hugged the ball tight. They were so glad! They learned that even when things go wrong, they can work together to fix it. And they kept playing all day.

Once there was a group of friends. They liked to play together and help each other. When one friend fell down, the others ran to help. They said, “It’s okay! You can do it!” They cheered when someone tried something new. They all felt happy and strong because they had each other. Together, they could do anything!  One day, they built a big tower with blocks. Some blocks fell down, and they all laughed. “Let’s try again!” said one friend. They worked as a team, and soon the tower was very tall. They jumped up and down with joy. They knew that being kind and helpful made their fun even better!

Once upon a time, there was a big, tall tree in a bright, green park. This tree was very special because it had a lot of big, round apples. One day, a little girl named Mia saw the apples. She wanted to pick one. She jumped and tried to reach them, but they were too high!  Mia did not give up. She found a big stick and used it to poke the apples. With a big poke, one apple fell down! Mia smiled and picked it up. She took a big bite and said, Yum! The tree was happy too, because it loved to share its apples with friends. And from that day, Mia visited the tree every week to say hello and eat more apples!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were two friends named Sam and Tim. They liked to play games together. One day, they wanted to build a big fort. Sam thought, “We need to use big boxes and soft blankets!” Tim said, “Yes! Let’s put the boxes by the tree and use the blankets on top!”   They worked together and had a plan. Sam carried the boxes, and Tim found the blankets. They took their time and made the fort just right. When they finished, they smiled and said, “Wow! We did it!” They sat inside their fort and felt very happy. The end.

Once there was a kind boy named Tim. Tim saw a little girl who was sad. She dropped her toy and it broke. Tim went to her and said, “I can help!” He picked up the pieces and gave her a hug. The girl smiled and felt happy again.   Later, Tim and the girl played together. They laughed and shared toys. Tim felt good because he helped his new friend. They both learned that being kind makes hearts feel warm.

Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big red ball. He liked to play with it in the sun. One day, Tim saw a dog. The dog was sad and had no home. Tim felt a tug in his heart. He knew he should help.   Tim took his ball and went to the dog. You can play! he said with a smile. The dog wagged its tail and jumped up. Tim and the dog played all day. They ran and rolled in the grass. Tim was happy he helped his new friend. Now they were both not sad!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a big, fluffy dog named Max. They played in the sun every day. They ran, jumped, and laughed a lot. One day, they found a shiny red ball. Sam and Max took turns kicking the ball and chasing it. They were so happy!  At the end of the day, the sun began to set. Sam and Max sat on the grass and watched the sky turn orange and pink. Sam said, “I love you, Max!” Max wagged his tail and licked Sam's face. They went home together, feeling very happy. The end.

Once there was a big group of kids who loved to play. They ran and jumped, laughing and having fun. But they did not watch where they were going. They ran too fast and tripped over each other. They fell on the grass and rolled around, giggling.   One day, a big dog came to play. The kids were happy and ran to pet him. But they were so silly and wild that they bumped into the dog! The dog barked and ran away. The kids learned to be careful and play nicely. They all wanted to have fun without being reckless!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia loved to draw. One day, she took her crayons and drew a big sun in the sky. It was bright and yellow. Then, she drew green grass and some blue flowers. Mia felt happy and smiled. She knew her drawings made her friends feel good too.  Mia showed her drawings to her friends. They all said, Wow! They wanted to draw too! So, they sat together and made a big picture of a happy day. They felt fun and loved each other. The end.

In a big, bright room, a girl named Mia had a fun idea. She wanted to play with her toys, but she could not pick just one. She saw her red car, her blue doll, and her green blocks. Mia thought, I want to play with all of them!   Mia sat on the soft rug and looked at her toys. She picked up the red car first and went vroom! Then, she took the blue doll and made her dance. Finally, she built a tall tower with the green blocks. Mia was very happy playing with all her toys. It was a nice day!

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Tim and Sam. Tim had a red ball, and Sam wanted to play. Tim said, I will share! They threw the ball back and forth, laughing and having fun.   One day, they saw a big tree. Tim said, Let's climb! Sam nodded and they climbed high. They could see the whole park! They shouted, Look at us! and waved to their families. Tim and Sam loved to play and talk. They were happy friends!

Once there were two friends, Sam and Tim. They liked to play in the park. One day, they found a big ball. Sam said, Let’s kick it! Tim said, Yes! They kicked the ball back and forth. They laughed and had fun. When the sun went down, they sat on the grass and shared some snacks. They felt happy together. The day ended, and they went home with big smiles. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Mia and Sam. Mia had a big box of crayons, and Sam liked to draw. One day, Mia said, “Let’s make a big picture together!” Sam smiled and nodded. They talked about what to draw.   Mia drew a big sun, and Sam drew a blue sky. They shared their crayons and helped each other. When they finished, they showed their picture to everyone. “Look!” they said. “We made this together!” They were happy because they talked and worked as a team.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Tim. Sam liked to run fast and play rough, but Tim liked to play soft and slow. One day, they played a game of tag in the park. Sam ran and jumped, but Tim wanted to take his time. Sam said, “Come on, Tim! Let’s play hard!” Tim smiled and said, “Okay, but let’s have fun!”  They both played and laughed. Sam was fast and wanted to win, but Tim showed him that playing nice was just as fun. In the end, they were happy together. They learned that it’s good to play hard, but it’s even better to play together and be kind. And that made them the best of friends!

Once there was a big, red ball. A boy named Tim had the ball. He liked to play with it every day. One sunny day, the ball went up in the sky. Tim ran to catch it, but it went too high! The ball hit a tree and went *pop!* Tim was sad.   But then, Tim saw his friend, Sue. She had a blue kite! The kite flew high in the sky. Tim smiled and said, Can I play? Sue said, Yes! So they ran and laughed. The ball was gone, but Tim found fun with his friend.

In a small town, there was a big, bright sun. One day, a girl named Sue saw a nice red kite in the sky. She wanted to fly it too! Sue ran to her friend, Tim. Look! she said, Can we fly kites?  Tim smiled and said, Yes! Let's do it! They both took their kites and ran. The wind was strong, and the kites flew high. Sue and Tim laughed and danced in the grass. They had a fun day, and they felt very happy with their big, bright kites!

Once there was a big boy named Sam. Sam loved to play with his friends. One day, they wanted to play tag, but some kids were sad. Sam saw their faces and said, “Let’s play together!” He smiled and ran fast. The sad kids joined in and soon everyone was happy. They laughed and played until the sun went down. Sam learned that being kind and brave made all the kids feel good. They all had fun together!

Once upon a time, there was a big man named Mike. Mike loved to help little kids. He showed them how to ride bikes and climb trees. The kids smiled and laughed when they learned new things. One day, a shy girl named Mia came to Mike. She wanted to learn how to paint. Mike took her hand and said, Let’s have fun!   They got some bright colors and big paper. Mike showed Mia how to make big swirls and dots. Mia was happy! She made a big rainbow on the paper. Mike clapped and said, You did it! Mia felt proud. She loved learning with Mike, her friend and helper. They painted and played until the sun went down.

Once there was a happy boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside with his friends. They ran, laughed, and had fun all day. One day, they found a big, green ball. They kicked it and chased it. The ball rolled far away, but they did not mind. They smiled and played together, and everyone was happy.   When the sun went down, Tim and his friends went home. They waved goodbye and said, See you tomorrow! They all felt good inside and knew they would play again. The day was fun, and everyone was friends.

Once upon a time, in a sunny town, there were many happy friends. They liked to help each other. When Sam fell down, his friend Tim ran to help him up. “You can do it!” Tim said with a smile. Sam felt better and tried again.   Later, Mia had a big box. It was too heavy for her. But her friends came to help. “We are here for you!” they said. Together, they lifted the box and put it where it needed to go. They all cheered and felt good. Helping each other made them all happy!

Once upon a time, a kind girl named Mia saw a cat in a tree. The cat was scared and could not come down. Mia said, Don’t worry, kitty! I will help you! She found a big, soft mat and put it below the tree.   Mia climbed up and gently picked up the kitty. She put the kitty on the mat. The kitty was safe! Mia smiled and said, You are okay now! The kitty purred and nuzzled Mia, happy to be free. They became best friends, and Mia took care of her new furry friend every day.

Once there was a big dog named Max. Max loved to run and play, but sometimes he got too excited. When he saw a ball, he would jump and bark loud. This made the little kids scared. They would say, No, Max! Be nice! But Max just wanted to have fun. One day, a kind girl named Mia came to play. She showed Max how to be gentle. Now, Max plays softly, and all the kids love him!

Once upon a time, there was a big man named Tom. Tom loved to help kids. He liked to show them how to ride bikes and climb trees. The kids liked Tom. They had fun with him.   One day, a little girl named Mia was sad. She wanted to ride her bike, but she was scared. Tom came over and said, I will help you! He held the bike while Mia got on. Slowly, she rode, and soon she was happy and smiling. Tom was a good friend and a great teacher. Mia loved to learn from him!

Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim was very happy when he played with his dog. They ran in the sun, and Tim laughed a lot. But one day, Tim lost his toy. He felt sad and cried. His mom gave him a hug and said, “It’s okay, Tim. We can find it!” Together, they looked and looked. When they found the toy, Tim felt so happy again! He learned that it’s okay to feel sad sometimes, but joy can come back.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big dog named Max. Tim loved Max very much, but one day, he forgot to give Max food and water. Max felt sad and hungry.   When Tim saw Max looking sad, he ran to the kitchen. He got food and water for his dog. Tim gave Max a big hug and said, I’m sorry! From that day on, Tim always took care of Max, and they played happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a kind man named Sam. Sam saw a little bird with a hurt wing. The bird could not fly. Sam felt sad for the bird. He took the bird home and gave it food and a soft bed.   Sam stayed up all night to help the bird feel better. In the morning, the bird was strong again. Sam opened the window and let the bird fly free. The bird chirped happily and flew high in the sky. Sam smiled because he helped a friend.

Once there was a big dog named Max. Max was happy and liked to play with his friend, Tim. One day, they saw a big ball. Max wanted the ball and ran fast to get it. But, oh no! He was too quick and bumped into Tim. Tim fell down and said, Ouch! Max felt sad. He didn't mean to be so rough. Max helped Tim up and said, Sorry! They both smiled and played with the ball together, nice and slow.

Once there was a girl named Mia. Mia was sad because her friend moved away. She wanted to play and laugh, but her heart felt heavy. Mia sat in her room, looking out the window.   One day, Mia saw a little bird. The bird sang a sweet song. Mia smiled and felt a bit better. She thought maybe she could find new friends. So, she went outside to play and look for fun. Mia learned that even when we feel sad, there can still be joy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big, fluffy dog named Max. They played in the sun, ran in the grass, and jumped in the mud. Tim and Max laughed and had fun together every day.  One day, they found a big, bright ball. They kicked it and chased it all around. Tim smiled wide, and Max wagged his tail. At the end of the day, they sat under a tree, tired but happy. They knew they would play again tomorrow!

Once there were two friends, Max and Sam. Max was a big boy, and Sam was a small boy. Max liked to help Sam learn new things. He showed Sam how to ride a bike. Sam was scared, but Max held the bike so it would not fall.   After many tries, Sam could ride all by himself! Sam was so happy. He smiled and said, Thank you, Max! Max felt proud. They both laughed and rode together, having fun in the sun. They were the best of friends, and Max was a great mentor for Sam.

Once there was a kind boy named Sam. Sam had a soft heart. He saw a sad dog in the park. The dog had a hurt leg. Sam sat down and spoke softly to the dog. “It’s okay, little friend. I will help you. ”   Sam took the dog to his home. He gave the dog water and food. He was gentle and nice. Soon, the dog felt better and wagged its tail. Sam and the dog became best friends. They played together every day, and Sam was happy to be kind.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a girl named Mia. One day, a big storm came. The wind blew hard, and the rain fell down. Mia was scared, but she took a deep breath and said, “I can be brave!” When the storm was over, Mia helped her friends clean up the mess. They picked up sticks and put away toys. They worked together and felt happy. Mia learned that even when things are hard, they can get better if they try!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a big, fluffy dog named Max. They played every day in the sun. They ran and jumped and had fun. One day, they found a blue ball. Sam threw the ball far, and Max ran fast to get it.   Max brought the ball back, and they laughed together. Then, they sat on the grass and shared a snack. Sam had a cookie, and Max had a treat. They were so happy. The sun shined bright, and they smiled big. It was a happy ending for Sam and Max!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were two friends named Mia and Sam. They liked to sit and talk. One day, Mia saw a new girl with a red hat. She said, “Look at her hat! It is so bright!” Sam smiled and said, “Yes! It is nice!”   They both giggled and whispered about the girl. Soon, other kids came over to listen. They all talked about the girl’s hat and wondered where she was from. But then, the girl with the red hat heard them and smiled too. She came over and said, “Thank you! I love my hat!” Now, they all played together, and everyone was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam saw a girl named Mia who looked sad. Mia lost her toy and did not know where to find it. Sam felt bad for her. He said, I can help you find your toy!   They looked high and low, and Sam helped Mia search. After a while, they found the toy under a big tree. Mia was so happy! She smiled and said, Thank you, Sam! You are a good friend. Sam felt happy too because he helped someone who was sad. They played together all day, laughing and having fun!

Once upon a time, in a big green park, there was a little girl named Mia. She loved to play with her dog, Max. One day, Mia and Max found a shiny rock. They thought it was special! They wanted to keep it safe. So, they made a small home for the rock with twigs and leaves.   Mia said, “This is our guard! We will watch it. ” Max barked happily. They sat by the rock and played games. The sun shined bright, and they felt happy. They knew their shiny rock was safe with them.

Once there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A happy girl named Mia played in the green grass. She had a cute dog named Max. They ran and laughed together. Mia tossed a ball, and Max chased it with joy.   As the sun went down, the sky turned orange and pink. Mia and Max sat on the grass, feeling warm and safe. They watched the stars twinkle. Mia said, This is a happy day! Max wagged his tail. They both felt love and joy. It was a happy ending.

Lily had a little dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball. One day, Lily threw the ball far. Max ran fast to get it. He was so happy!   Lily and Max played in the sun. They laughed and had fun. When it was time to go home, Max was tired. Lily gave him a big hug. You are my best friend, she said. Max wagged his tail and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a big man named Matt. Matt loved to help little kids. One day, he saw a small boy named Tim. Tim wanted to ride his bike but was scared. Matt said, “I can help you!”   Matt showed Tim how to ride. He held the bike and said, “Pedal fast!” Tim pedaled and smiled. Matt cheered, “You can do it!” Soon, Tim rode all by himself. He was happy! Tim said, “Thank you, Matt! You are a great friend!” They laughed and rode bikes together every day.

Once there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his big red ball. One day, he saw a big, green frog. The frog jumped and made a big splash in the pond. Tim laughed and wanted to play with the frog. He said, Jump, frog, jump!  The frog jumped high and then low. Tim tried to jump like the frog, but he fell in the grass. He giggled and got up. Then Tim and the frog played all day by the pond, having fun and making silly sounds. They were happy friends!

Once there was a boy named Ben. Ben had a big blue ball. He loved to play with it every day. One day, the ball rolled away and got stuck in a big bush. Ben tried to get it, but the thorns were sharp. He felt sad and did not know what to do.  Then, a nice girl named Ana came by. She saw Ben and asked, What is wrong? Ben told her about the ball. Ana said, Let’s work together! They gently pulled the ball from the bush. Ben was so happy! They played with the ball until the sun went down. The end.

Once there were two friends, Sam and Max. They liked to run and jump. One day, they ran in the park and played with a big ball. They were so happy! But then, Sam ran too fast and tripped over a rock. He fell down and got a small boo-boo on his knee. Max helped him up and said, Be careful, Sam! They laughed and played again, but this time they watched where they ran. They had fun and were safe!

Once there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a soft heart. He saw a sad dog. The dog had no home and no food. Sam felt sad too. He took some bread from his lunch and gave it to the dog. The dog wagged its tail and looked happy. Sam smiled big!   Then, Sam saw a girl who fell down. She hurt her knee and cried. Sam ran to help her. He gave her a hug and said, “It’s okay!” The girl felt better and smiled back. Sam liked to help, and he liked to share love with his friends and with all the animals.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a kind man named Tom. Tom loved to help kids learn new things. He would show them how to ride bikes and play games. The kids liked Tom a lot and called him their friend.   One day, a shy girl named Mia wanted to learn to draw. Tom sat with her and showed her how to hold the pencil. He smiled and said, You can do it! With Tom's help, Mia drew a big sun and a happy face. Mia was so happy! She knew that with a friend like Tom, she could learn anything.

Once there was a big, red dog named Sid. Sid was very nice but he could not decide what to do. One day, Sid wanted to play with a ball. Then he saw a stick and thought, “Is the stick more fun?” He ran to the ball and then to the stick. Sid could not pick!   His friend, a small cat named Ivy, came to help. She said, “Sid, why not play with both?” Sid smiled and wagged his tail. He took the ball with his mouth and the stick in his paws. Now, Sid was happy! He ran and played with Ivy all day long.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Mia had a big dog named Max. Mia and Max played in the sun every day. They ran and jumped, laughing so loud! One day, they found a small blue ball. They kicked it and chased it around the park.   At the end of the day, Mia and Max were very happy. They lay down on the grass, looking at the fluffy clouds. Mia said, I love you, Max! Max wagged his tail. They both smiled and felt warm inside. It was a very happy ending!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia felt sad because she lost her favorite toy. She looked for it under the bed and behind the chair, but it was not there. Mia sat on the floor and cried.   Her mom came and gave her a big hug. It’s okay, sweetie, she said. We can find it together! Mia smiled a little. They looked in the yard and in the box. Finally, they found the toy in the grass! Mia felt so happy and hugged her mom tight. They both laughed and danced in the sun.

Once there was a big, happy family. They had a nice house, but it was very messy. There were toys on the floor, crumbs on the table, and clothes everywhere! The kids liked to play, but they forgot to help clean up.   One day, their mom said, Let's clean together! They picked up toys, wiped the table, and put clothes in the basket. The house looked nice again! The kids smiled and felt happy. They learned that helping makes home fun!

Once there were two friends named Sam and Max. They loved to run and play in the park. One sunny day, they saw a big hill. Let’s climb! said Sam. They ran up the hill, but they were very reckless. They did not look where they stepped. Suddenly, Max slipped and fell! He rolled down the hill and landed in the soft grass. Sam laughed and said, You are okay! Max stood up, smiled, and said, That was fun! Let’s do it again, but be careful this time! They both giggled and climbed the hill together, watching where they stepped.

Once upon a time, in a big, bright land, there was a tall tree. This tree was very special because it had many fruits. People came from far away to pick the sweet fruits. They would laugh and play under the tree. One day, a big wind blew, and the tree shook. The fruits fell down, and everyone cheered! They picked up the fruits and shared them with joy. The tree was happy, and so were the people. They danced and sang under the big, blue sky.

Once there was a big, red ball. The ball was round and fun. One day, a boy named Sam kicked the ball. It went far and hit a tree. The ball popped! Sam was sad. He wanted to play with the ball again.   But then, Sam saw a little dog. The dog had a wagging tail. Sam smiled and played with the dog. They ran and jumped together. Sam forgot about the ball. Sometimes, a sad thing can lead to a happy thing!

Once there were some kids who loved to play outside. One day, it rained a lot. The kids felt sad because they could not play. But then, they had a great idea! They put on their boots and grabbed big umbrellas. They ran outside and splashed in the puddles. They laughed and had fun, even in the rain!  After the rain, the sun came out. The kids saw a big rainbow in the sky. They felt happy again. They knew that even when things are hard, they can still find joy. They were strong and brave, just like a big tree that stands tall in the wind.

Once there was a big, happy family. They liked to play outside all day. They ran, jumped, and danced in the sun. But one day, they were very silly. They ran too fast and fell down! They laughed and got up, but they were a bit hurt.   The mom said, “Let’s be careful next time!” The kids nodded and smiled. They played again, but this time, they were not so wild. They had fun and stayed safe. Happy times are best when we are safe!

Once there was a big storm. The wind blew hard and the rain fell down. A little boy named Tim and his dog Max were scared. But they held hands and stayed close. They sang a happy song to make the storm feel less scary.  When the storm went away, Tim and Max saw a big rainbow in the sky. They smiled and jumped for joy! They learned that even when things are tough, they can be strong and brave. Together, they can face anything.

Once there was a big, happy dog named Max. Max loved to play with a boy named Tim. They ran in the sun, jumped in the grass, and laughed a lot. One day, they found a ball. Max chased the ball, but oh no! It went too far! Max ran and ran, but he fell in a mud puddle. He was all dirty! Tim laughed and said, “You are a silly dog!”   Max shook off the mud and wagged his tail. Tim gave Max a hug. They went home together, and Tim gave Max a nice bath. Now Max was clean and happy again! They played more, and the sun went down. It was a good day with a happy ending.

Once upon a time, in a big green park, there was a kind girl named Mia. She loved to play with her friends and help them when they fell. One day, Mia saw a tiny bird on the ground. The bird looked sad and could not fly.   Mia picked up the bird gently and took it to her house. She gave it food and water. Every day, she took care of the bird, and soon it got strong. One sunny day, the bird flapped its wings and flew into the sky. Mia smiled and felt happy because she helped her new friend.

Once there was a little girl named Sid. Sid loved to play. One day, she saw a big red ball. She wanted to kick it, but she didn’t know if she should. “What if it rolls away?” she thought.   Sid sat down and looked at the ball. She wanted to play, but she felt shy. Then, her friend, Ed, came by. “Let’s kick the ball!” he said with a big smile. Sid smiled back and said, “Okay!” Together, they kicked the ball and had so much fun! Sid learned that it is good to try new things with a friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big, tall tree. The tree had many leaves and lots of shade. One sunny day, a little boy named Timmy played under the tree. He liked to climb and pretend he was a big bird.   One day, a big, loud wind came. The tree shook and swayed. Timmy held on tight. The wind went away, and the tree was safe. Timmy smiled and said, You are a strong tree! They both felt happy, and Timmy played a little more.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a kind girl named Lily. She loved to help her friends. One day, the kids wanted to play a game, but they could not decide what to play. Lily had an idea! She said, “Let’s take turns and let everyone pick a game!” The kids smiled and nodded. They played many games and had fun together.  Lily showed them how to be good friends. She listened to everyone and helped them feel happy. All the kids liked Lily because she was a good leader. They knew they could always play together and have fun because of her. And so, they played every day, laughing and smiling, thanks to their kind leader, Lily.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Mia. They loved to play together every day. One sunny day, Sam wanted to fly a red kite, but Mia wanted to play with a blue ball. Sam said, I want to fly the kite! Mia said, I want to kick the ball!   They sat down and talked. Sam said, How about we take turns? Mia smiled and said, Yes! First the kite, then the ball! So, they flew the kite high in the sky and then kicked the ball around. They were happy because they talked and shared their fun!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia and a boy named Ben. Mia had a big red ball, and Ben wanted to play. Mia said, “Hi, Ben! Do you want to play?” Ben smiled and said, “Yes! I want to play!” They threw the ball back and forth.   Then, Mia had an idea. She said, “Let’s make a game!” Ben clapped his hands and said, “Okay! Let’s play catch!” They laughed and had fun. They talked and shared, and they were happy. Mia and Ben learned that talking and playing makes friends feel good!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Bob. Bob had a big red ball. One day, his friend Lily came over. She said, “Can I play with your ball?” Bob smiled and said, “Yes! We can play together!”  They ran and kicked the ball in the sun. It was fun to share! Then, Lily said, “Now, it is my turn to show you my toy. ” She brought out a blue kite. Bob was happy! They took turns playing and had a great day. Sharing made them both feel good!

Once upon a time, there was a big group of kids. They wanted to build a fort. The kids sat down and thought hard. They said, “Let’s use big sticks and soft leaves!”   They worked together. Once there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A girl named Mia wanted to play outside. She saw her friend Ben. Come play! she said. But Ben was not sure. He thought, What if it rains? Once there was a big bear named Ben. Ben loved to hug all his friends. He hugged the tall trees, the soft grass, and even the bright flowers. But one day, he saw his friends were sad. Once upon a time, there was a big, happy garden. In this garden, there were bright flowers, green leaves, and tasty fruits. Many kids loved to play there. Once there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys, but he often forgot to put them away. One day, his mom said, “Tim, you need to clean up!” Tim did not listen. Once upon a time, in a sunny land, there was a happy boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside with his dog, Max. One day, Tim saw a big tree with bright green leaves. Once there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars. One day, he felt very happy because he got a new red car. He smiled and jumped with joy.   But then, Tim lost his red car. Once upon a time, a man named Tim had a magic map. The map could show him where to find fun things. One day, Tim saw a big, bright sun. He wanted to play in the sun, so he followed the map. Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim had a big idea. He wanted to help his friend, Sue, who was sad. Tim saw that Sue's toy was broken. He thought hard and found some tape. Once there was a boy named Sam. Sam liked to play with his dog, Max. They ran in the sun and jumped in the grass. One day, they found a big tree. Sam said, “Let’s sit!” Max wagged his tail. Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Tim. They loved to talk and share stories. One day, they saw a big cat in the yard. Did you see that cat? Sam asked. Tim said, Yes! Once upon a time, there was a big, warm town. In this town, all the people were very kind. They helped each other every day. One day, a little girl saw a puppy by a tree. Once there was a little boy named Tim. Tim felt sad and alone. He wanted to play, but he did not tell anyone. He sat by himself and looked at the ground.   One day, a kind girl named Sue saw Tim. Once there was a little boy named Sam. Sam loved to play outside. One day, it rained and the sky was gray. Sam felt sad, but he wanted to play. He put on his big boots and took his red umbrella. Once upon a time, there was a man named Tim. Tim loved to help kids. He would take them to the park and show them how to play. One day, he met a shy boy named Sam. Once there was a big, kind man named Carl. He loved to help his friends. One day, Carl saw a small cat in a tree. The cat was scared and could not get down. Carl said, “Don’t worry, little cat. Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a big heart and liked to help his friends. One day, his friend Tim fell and hurt his knee. Sam ran to Tim and said, “It’s okay, Tim! Once there was a little girl named Mia. One day, it rained a lot, and she could not play outside. Mia felt sad, but she did not give up. She took her toys and made a fun game inside. In a sunny park, a girl named Mia saw a little bird. The bird was hurt and could not fly. Mia felt sad for the bird. She gently picked it up and said, Don’t worry, friend. I will help you. Once there was a big, happy town. All the people liked to play and share. One day, they found a big box. Inside the box were toys! Everyone cheered and took out a toy. Once there was a big dog named Max. Max liked to play, but sometimes he would bark loud and chase the cats. The cats got scared and ran away. One day, Max saw a little girl with a ball. Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Sam. Sam loved to play outside with his friends. One day, they found a hurt bird. The bird could not fly. Sam felt sad for the bird. Once upon a time, a girl named Mia had a big, fluffy dog. They played in the park every day. One day, Mia and her dog ran too far from home. They saw a big tree and thought it was fun to climb. Once upon a time, there was a big, green garden. In this garden, lived a happy man named Gary. Gary loved to care for his plants. He watered them and gave them sun. Once upon a time, there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A little girl named Mia loved to play outside. She ran and jumped with her friends. They laughed and had fun all day. Once upon a time, there was a man named Max. Max loved to play with his fun toys. One day, he found a big red box. Inside the box was a small robot. Max loved the robot and wanted to make it move. Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia and a boy named Max. Mia had a big smile, and Max liked to wave. One day, they met in the park. Mia said, Hi! and Max said, Hello! Once upon a time, there was a big, green frog named Greg. Greg liked to jump and play. One day, he saw some ants on the ground. Greg wanted to play with them, but he was too big. Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big heart. He liked to help his friends. One day, he saw a cat stuck in a tree. Tim climbed the tree and got the cat down. Once there was a big, happy town. Everyone played and laughed. But one day, the sky got dark, and the people felt sad. They sat quietly and did not smile. In a big, bright room, a man named Max had a magic hat. The hat could make toys dance and sing. Max loved to play with his friends, Mia and Pip. One day, they took turns wearing the hat. Once upon a time, there was a kind man named Sam. Sam saw a little bird with a hurt wing. The bird could not fly. Sam wanted to help, so he took off his warm coat. Once upon a time, there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A happy girl named Mia played in the green grass. She had a red ball. Mia kicked the ball far, and it rolled down a hill. Oh no! Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim felt sad. He wanted to play with his friends, but they were busy. Tim sat alone on a swing. He looked at the sky and took a deep breath. Once upon a time, in a bright and happy town, there lived many friends. They loved to talk and share. One day, Mia saw Tom sitting alone. She waved and said, Hi, Tom! Tom smiled and waved back. Once there was a big, tall tree. It had thick, green leaves and strong, brown bark. One sunny day, a little girl named Anna saw the tree. She loved to play by it. Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim saw a girl named Mia sitting alone on a swing. She looked sad. Once there was a big, green tree in a sunny park. A girl named Mia loved this tree. One day, she saw a bird with a hurt wing. The bird could not fly. Mia felt sad for the bird. She wanted to help. Once there were two friends, Max and Sam. Max was happy and liked to play. Sam was not happy and wanted to fight. Max said, “Let’s play ball!” But Sam shouted, “No! I want to win!” Max felt sad. One day, a big man named Tim saw a tall tree. The tree was very green and nice. Tim said, I want to climb that tree! He climbed up and up. But then, Tim felt scared. Once upon a time, in a sunny park, a girl named Sue had a big, red ball. She loved to play with her friends. One day, her ball got stuck in a tree. Sue felt sad. Her friends came to help. Once there was a big cat. The cat was nice and loved to play. One day, the cat saw a dog. The dog was small and sad. The cat wanted to help the dog.   The cat said, Come and play! Once upon a time, there was a man named Tim. Tim had a big map. He wanted to go to a fun place. So, he took his map and made a plan. He drew a line to show where to go.   Tim walked and walked. In a small town, there were two friends named Sam and Mia. One day, they sat on a big rock and started to talk. Sam said, Did you see that new girl? She has a red hat! Mia giggled and said, Yes! Once upon a time, in a sunny park, there were two friends named Sam and Mia. They liked to play with a red ball. One day, they kicked the ball too far, and it went into a big bush. Once upon a time, a boy named Tim had a big red balloon. He loved his balloon very much. One day, the wind blew, and up, up, up it went! Tim felt sad as he watched it fly away. Once upon a time, there was a big, tall tree. The tree was very old and had many leaves. One day, a little girl named Tia sat under the tree. She loved the shade and the soft grass. Once there was a man named Tim. Tim felt sad all the time. He did not smile or laugh. His friends tried to make him happy, but Tim felt heavy in his heart.   One day, a little cat came to Tim. Once upon a time, there was a boy named Ben. Ben had a big red ball. He loved to play with it every day. One sunny day, Ben threw the ball high in the sky. But oh no! Once there was a nice man named Carl. Carl had a big heart and loved to help. One day, he saw a sad dog by the tree. The dog had no food and looked tired. Once upon a time, there was a big group of friends. They liked to talk and share. One day, they sat in a circle. They used their mouths to say words and their hands to show what they felt. Once there was a big, bright sun in the sky. It made the flowers bloom and the trees sway. A boy named Sam and a girl named Mia liked to play outside. Once upon a time, there was a big, happy family. They had a dog named Max. Every day, the family played with Max in the yard. They tossed a ball, and Max ran fast to catch it. In a small town, there were two friends, Mia and Jay. They liked to sit and talk. Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a kind man named Sam. Sam saw a big fire in the woods. He ran fast to help the little animals. They were scared and lost. Once upon a time, there was a big man named Tim. Tim loved to help kids. He would take them to the park and teach them how to play. One day, he met a shy girl named Mia. Once upon a time, there was a kind man named Tim. Tim loved to help kids learn new things. One sunny day, he saw a little girl named Mia. Mia wanted to ride her bike, but she was scared. Once there was a big dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball. One day, he ran too fast and fell down. He hurt his paw and could not walk well. He knew that sharing made him feel good. From that day on, Sam always helped his friends, and they loved him for it.

Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big red balloon. One day, the wind blew hard, and his balloon flew away. Tim felt very sad. He sat on the ground and cried.   But then, Tim saw a girl with a blue balloon. She smiled at him and said, You can play with me! Tim felt happy again. They laughed and ran together, and soon, Tim forgot all about his lost balloon. Now, they were friends and had fun every day!

Once upon a time, there was a big red dog named Sid. Sid loved to play with his best friend, Tim. One day, they saw a big ball. Sid wanted to play with the ball, but Tim said, “No! The ball is too big!” Sid felt sad. He did not want to stop playing.  But then, Sid had an idea! He asked Tim, “What if we push the ball together?” Tim smiled and said, “Yes! Let’s try!” They both pushed the ball. It rolled and rolled! Now they could play together. Sid was happy, and so was Tim. They learned that working together is fun!

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim had a big dog named Max. Tim loved to play with Max in the sun. One day, they saw a big tree with a swing. Tim had a fun idea! He ran to the tree and said, Max, let’s play on the swing!  Max wagged his tail and jumped around. Tim climbed on the swing and went up and down. Max barked and ran in circles. They both felt happy. Tim knew that playing with Max made every day bright. They played until the sun went down, and then they went home, tired but glad.

Once there were some kids who loved to play. They ran fast and jumped high. They were so happy! But one day, they were a bit too wild. They ran on the grass and fell down. Some got muddy, and some got hurt. Their moms said, “Be careful, kids!” The kids laughed and promised to be more safe. They still played but went slow and had fun without falling.

Once upon a time, there was a big, happy town. In this town, everyone helped each other. If a friend needed help, they would say, I can do it! Some friends baked bread, while others picked flowers. They all worked together to make the town nice.  One day, a little girl saw her friend looking sad. She asked, What is wrong? Her friend said, I need help to find my lost toy. The little girl said, I will help you! They looked high and low, and soon they found the toy. The friend smiled and said, Thank you for helping me! The little girl felt happy because helping friends is a good thing to do!

Once there was a big, happy family. They loved to play games in the sun. One day, the kids ran and jumped all around. They were so silly! They kicked a ball too hard, and it went into a pond. Splash! Water flew everywhere! The kids laughed and got wet.   Their mom and dad said, “Be careful!” But the kids just smiled and kept having fun. They made big, splashy waves and played in the water. Even when they were a bit messy, they were still happy and loved each other very much.

Mia and her friend, Tim, had a big plan. They wanted to make a tall tower with blocks. Mia picked up one block and put it on top of another. Tim saw and said, “Let me help!” They both smiled and worked hard.   Soon, the tower was very high! But then, oh no! A big cat came in and knocked it down. Mia and Tim laughed and said, “Let’s build it again!” They picked up the blocks and made an even bigger tower together. They were happy!

Lily loved to play with her dog, Max. One sunny day, they went to the park. Lily threw a big ball, and Max ran fast to catch it. “Good boy, Max!” she cheered. They played all afternoon, laughing and having fun.  Later, they sat under a tree. Lily shared her snack of apples. Max wagged his tail and looked happy. “Let’s go home now,” said Lily. Hand in paw, they walked back, tired but very glad. Lily smiled and said, “I love you, Max!”

Once upon a time, there was a big, happy dog named Max. Max loved to play with his friend, a little boy named Sam. They would run and jump in the sun, and they laughed a lot. One day, Max saw a big, red ball. He ran to get it, but as he ran, he tripped and fell. Sam rushed to help Max up. Max was okay, but he was sad because he wanted to play more. Sam gave Max a hug and said, Let's play again! Max wagged his tail and felt happy again. They both smiled, and they played until the sun went down.

Once there were two kids named Sam and Max. Sam was big and Max was small. One day, they found a big ball. Sam wanted to kick the ball far, but Max wanted to play gently. Sam kicked hard, and the ball flew away! Max got sad.   Then, Max said, “Let’s share!” Sam smiled. They took turns kicking the ball nice and soft. Now they were happy, and the ball stayed close. They played together and had fun!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a nice boy named Leo. Leo loved to play with his friends. One day, they wanted to play a game, but no one knew what to do. Leo said, “I can help! Leo was a great leader because he helped his friends play together. At the end of the day, they all said, “Thank you, Leo!” and they felt happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big, happy town. In this town, all the kids loved to play together. They played tag and jumped rope. One day, a little boy named Tim saw his friend, Sam, sitting alone. Everyone felt good because they helped each other. They learned that being nice is what friends do!

Once there was a boy named Max. Max had a big red ball. He loved to play with it in the sun. One day, he kicked the ball too hard, and it rolled away. Max ran after it, laughing and smiling. The sun shined, and the world was bright. Max went home with his ball, and everything was just fine.

Once upon a time, a big bear and a little rabbit were friends. They played in the green grass and ate sweet berries. One day, the bear saw a big, red apple on a tall tree. The bear smiled and said, “I am fine! Just a bit sad. ” The rabbit gave the bear a hug. They both learned that playing safe is best. From that day, they played together but stayed on the ground, where it was safe and fun.

Once there was a man named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys. One day, he saw a big red ball. Tim picked up the ball and threw it. The ball went high in the air and landed in a big puddle.   Tim ran to the puddle, jumped in, and splashed water everywhere! He laughed and laughed. Now the ball was wet, but Tim didn’t mind. He loved to play with the ball and have fun in the puddle. Once there was a big, big tree. The tree was tall and wide. Many happy kids played under the tree. They laughed and sang. One day, a little boy found a tiny bug by the tree. The bug made them smile, and they played happily all day long. The tree, the boy, and the bug were all friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a big man named Max. Max loved to help other kids. He showed them how to ride bikes and play games. The kids looked up to him. Max was a good friend and a great teacher. Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a big dog named Max. They played in the sun and ran in the grass. Sam threw a ball, and Max ran fast to catch it. Once upon a time, there was a nice man named Carl. Carl had a big heart. He loved to help his friends. One day, a little bird fell from a tree. Day by day, the bird grew strong. Soon, it was time for the bird to fly. Carl opened the window and said, “Go, little bird. You are free!” The bird flew high in the sky, and Carl smiled. He felt happy because he cared.

Once upon a time, in a sunny town, there lived a big girl named Mia and a small boy named Tim. Mia loved to talk. She would say, Hello! and How are you? Tim liked to smile and nod. They played games and had fun. One day, Mia wanted to play hide and seek. She said, You count, and I will hide! Tim counted to ten and then said, Ready or not, here I come! Once upon a time, there was a big man named Tim. Tim loved to help little kids learn. He would show them how to tie their shoes and ride bikes. The kids liked Tim a lot. Once upon a time, there was a big, green garden. In this garden, many kids played. They ran, jumped, and laughed. The sun was bright, and the flowers were pretty. Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play in the sun and run in the grass. One day, he saw a small bird. The bird was sad and could not fly. Tim felt bad for the bird. Once there was a big man named Greg. Greg liked to play games, but he was very loud and rough. He would shout and jump when he played. One day, his friend Sam came to play. Sam was quiet and liked to play soft games.   Greg saw Sam and said, “Let’s be loud and jump!” But Sam said, “No, let’s play nice. ” Greg thought for a moment and then smiled. “Okay!” he said. They had fun playing together, laughing and being happy. Greg learned that it was good to play soft sometimes too.

Once there was a big, happy park. Many kids ran and played. They flew kites and rode bikes. But some kids were a bit reckless. They ran too fast and jumped too high. One day, a boy named Max ran and tripped on a rock. He fell down and scraped his knee. His friends came and helped him up. They said, Be careful, Max! Let’s play safe! Max smiled and nodded. From that day, they all played and had fun but remembered to be careful!

Once there was a big man named Tim. Tim loved to help little kids. He would show them how to tie their shoes and ride their bikes. The kids loved Tim. They would shout, Tim is our friend!  One day, a shy girl named Mia came to play. She did not know how to ride a bike. Tim took her hand and said, I will help you. With a big smile, he showed her how to pedal. Soon, Mia was riding fast! She was so happy. Tim clapped and said, You did it! Mia felt brave and loved to ride her bike with her new friend, Tim.

Once upon a time, there was a big, mean giant named Tyrannical. He lived in a tall, dark tower. The giant would shout at everyone and take their toys. The kids in the town were very sad and scared.   One day, a brave girl named Mia decided to help. She made a plan. Mia and her friends brought lots of bright flowers to the tower. They sang a happy song. The giant heard the song and came out. When he saw the flowers, he smiled! The giant gave back the toys and promised to be nice. The town was happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a big, fluffy dog named Max. They played in the sun, ran in the grass, and found pretty flowers. Sam and Max were very happy. At the end of the day, they hugged and said, “Let’s play again!” And they all felt very, very happy.

Once upon a time, in a sunny town, there lived a little girl named Mia. Mia had a big smile and loved to play with her friends. One day, they found a lost puppy. The puppy was small and scared. Mia and her friends gave the puppy food and water. They played with him and made him feel safe.   Soon, the puppy was happy and wagged his tail. Mia and her friends decided to name him Max. They took Max to the park, where he ran and jumped with joy. Everyone laughed and played together. At the end of the day, Mia, her friends, and Max were all very happy. They went home with big smiles, ready to play again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Tim. They wanted to play a game, but they did not know which game to play. Sam said, “Let’s think!” They sat on the grass and thought hard. Tim had an idea. “What if we play hide and seek?” Sam smiled. “Yes! That is fun!”   They counted to ten, and then Tim hid behind a big tree. Sam looked and looked. He used his brain to think of the best places to look. After a while, Sam found Tim and they laughed. They had a great time playing together, using their smart thinking to make the game even more fun!

Once upon a time, there was a big, tall man named Tim. Tim loved to play with his dog, Max. One day, Tim and Max went to the park. They saw a big tree and a shiny ball. Tim threw the ball, and Max ran fast to catch it.   But then, a big, furry cat came and scared Max! Max barked loudly, and Tim said, Don't be scared, Max! The cat ran away. Tim hugged Max and said, You are brave! They played all day and had so much fun together.

Once there was a boy named Sam. Sam loved to play with his toys, but sometimes his friend Tim took them without asking. One day, Sam said, No, Tim! Please ask me first. Tim looked sad, but Sam smiled and said, It's okay to ask. We can share. From that day on, Tim asked before he played with Sam's toys, and they had fun together. Sam felt proud to say what he wanted.

Once upon a time, there was a kind man named Sam. Sam had a big heart. One day, he saw a little cat stuck in a tree. The cat was scared and meowed for help. Sam loved cats, so he climbed the tree to save the cat. He took a deep breath and reached out his hand. The cat came to him, and Sam held it tight.  After that, Sam took the cat home. He gave it food and a soft bed. Sam was happy to help, even though his hands were tired. The cat purred and snuggled close to Sam. They became best friends, and Sam knew that helping others made his heart feel warm.

Once there was a big group of friends. They loved to play together. When one friend fell down, the others ran to help. They said nice words like, You can do it! and We are here! They all cheered when their friend got up and smiled.   Every day, they played games and shared toys. They always helped each other, like when someone needed a hug or a hand. Together, they were happy and strong. They knew being kind made their hearts feel good!

Once there was a boy named Ben. Ben had a big red ball. He loved to play with it in the sun. One day, the ball went up, up high and got stuck in a tree. Ben was sad. He wanted his ball back.  Then, Ben had an idea! He asked his friend, Ed, to help him. Ed brought a long stick. They poked the ball, and it fell down! Ben was so happy. He hugged Ed and said, Thank you, friend! They played together until the sun went down. The end.

Once there was a big, strong man named Tyran. He liked to play with his friends. One day, Tyran saw a tall tree. The tree was very big and green. Tyran wanted to climb it, so he called his friends. They all came to help.   Tyran climbed the tree, and his friends cheered. Go, Tyran, go! they said. Tyran reached the top and saw a big blue sky. He felt happy and shouted, I can see everything! His friends clapped, and they all had fun under the tree. They played all day and were very, very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia loved her friend, Sam. One day, Sam looked sad. Mia wanted to help him feel better. She gave him a big hug and said, It's okay, Sam. I am here.   Sam smiled a little. Mia then shared her toys and played nice games with him. They laughed and had fun together. Sam felt happy again, and they were best friends forever!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were four friends: Sam, Mia, Tom, and Sue. They loved to talk and share stories. One sunny day, they sat under a big tree. Sam said, Did you hear about the new girl? Mia nodded and said, I saw her! She has a red hat! Tom smiled and said, I heard she can jump very high! Sue giggled and said, I want to meet her!   The friends kept talking and sharing their fun thoughts. They whispered and laughed, making the day bright. Soon, they decided to go find the new girl. They ran and played, happy to make a new friend. The sun shined, and all was good in their little town.

Once there was a girl named Mia. Mia had a big heart and always helped her friends. One day, her dog, Max, ran away. Mia felt sad but knew she had to find him. She looked in the park, by the tree, and near the pond.   Then, she heard a bark! Mia ran to the sound and found Max stuck in a bush. She gently pulled him out. Mia was so happy! Max licked her face, and they both went home to play. Mia knew it was good to trust her heart and help.

Once there was a big dog. The dog was very happy and liked to play. One day, a small cat came to the yard. The dog saw the cat and ran fast. The dog wanted to play, but the cat was scared. The cat ran up a tree. The dog stopped and sat down. The dog was not mad; he just wanted a friend.  Then, the cat looked down and saw the dog. The cat felt safe. Slowly, the cat came down the tree. The dog wagged his tail and smiled. They played together, and soon they were best friends. Now, the dog and the cat play every day. They are happy and love to share!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Sam. Sam had a big smile and loved to play with his friends. But one day, he felt sad. He wanted to be happy, but he could not. He kept his sad feelings inside, and he tried to smile.   Sam's friends noticed he was not his usual happy self. They asked him, What is wrong? Sam took a deep breath and told them, I feel sad. His friends gave him big hugs and said, It’s okay to feel sad. We are here for you! Sam smiled again because he knew he was not alone. They all played together and made him feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a kind man named Sam. Sam had a big heart and loved to help his friends. One day, his friend, a little dog named Max, got stuck in a bush. Sam saw Max and ran to help. He got hurt a little, but he did not care. He pulled Max out and smiled. Max wagged his tail and licked Sam’s face, so happy to be free.  Sam went home with a small cut, but he felt good. He knew helping Max was more important than his owie. Sam learned that being kind and helping others can make you feel warm inside, even if you have to share a little hurt. Sam and Max played together every day after that, happy to be friends.

Once there were two friends, Sam and Tim. They wanted to play a game but could not decide which game to play. Sam thought, “Let’s think! What can we do?” Tim said, “We can ask each other what we like!” So, they sat on the grass and talked.   Sam liked to run, and Tim liked to draw. They had a great idea! They would run for a little while and then sit and draw pictures of the fun they had. They smiled and jumped with joy because they used their brains to make a fun plan.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a big heart and loved to help his friends. One sunny day, Sam saw his friend Mia looking sad. She wanted to play but was too shy to ask. Sam took a deep breath and said, Mia, do you want to play with me?   Mia smiled and said, Yes! They ran to the swings and had so much fun. Sam felt happy because he was brave and spoke up. Once upon a time, in a big green park, there was a kind girl named Mia. Mia loved to play with her friends. One day, she saw a little bird that fell from its nest. The bird was sad and scared. Mia felt sad too. She gently picked up the bird and held it close. Don't be scared, she said softly.   Mia and her friends made a small nest with leaves and twigs. They put the bird in the nest and watched over it. Soon, the bird felt safe and happy. Then, with a flap of its wings, it flew back to its home in the tree. Mia smiled and felt warm inside. She knew that being kind and caring made the world a better place.

Once upon a time, there was a big team of kids. They wanted to play a game. They sat down to think. They said, Let’s use our brains! They thought about how to win. They made a plan. They said, Let’s run fast and help each other.  When the game started, they ran and played. They helped their friends when they fell down. They shared the ball and cheered for one another. In the end, they had fun, and everyone was happy. They learned that thinking together is the best way to play!

Once upon a time, there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A happy girl named Mia saw the sun and smiled. She ran outside to play with her friends. They laughed and jumped, and they made a big game of tag.   The friends played until the sun went down. They were tired but very happy. Mia and her friends sat on the grass and watched the stars come out. They knew that even though the day was done, they would play again tomorrow. And that made them all feel good inside. The end.

Once upon a time, in a sunny park, there were two friends, Max and Mia. Max was big and strong, and he loved to help Mia learn new things. Mia was small but very smart. She took his hand and said, “Let’s run fast!” They ran together, laughing and having fun. Max smiled and said, “You are a great friend!” They learned from each other every day, and that made them the best team in the park.

Once there was a little girl named Mia. Mia was very brave. One day, she saw a big dog. The dog looked scary, but Mia stood tall. She said, Hello, dog! I am not afraid! Once upon a time, there was a big group of kids. They wanted to play a game, but they did not know what to do. Once there were two kids, Sam and Tim. Sam was very big, and Tim was very small. One day, they played a game. Sam wanted to win, so he pushed Tim. Tim felt sad and did not want to play anymore.   Then, a nice dog came by. The dog wagged its tail and made both boys smile. Once upon a time, there were two friends, Bob and Lily. They liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big, red ball. Bob wanted to kick the ball, but Lily said, Wait! We must share! So, they took turns. Bob kicked the ball, and then Lily kicked it too. They laughed and had fun. Sharing made their game better, and they were happy!

Once there was a boy named Sam. Sam felt many big feelings. Sometimes he was happy, like when he saw a bright sun. Other times, he was sad, like when his toy broke. Once there was a girl named Mia. Mia saw her friend Tom fall and scrape his knee. She ran to him and said, Oh no, Tom! Are you okay? Tom looked sad and hurt. Mia gave him a hug and said, I will help you. She brought him a soft band-aid. Tom smiled a little and felt better. They sat and talked, and soon they both laughed. Mia felt happy to help her friend.

Once upon a time, in a bright green park, lived a kind man named Gus. Gus loved to help. He would pick up trash, water the flowers, and feed the birds. All the kids in the park called him Gus the Guardian because he took care of the park like a big friend.   One sunny day, a little girl named Mia lost her red ball. She cried, Help! Mia was so happy! She hugged Gus and said, Thank you, Guardian Gus! They played with the ball until the sun went down, and everyone in the park felt glad.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. One sunny day, he saw a little bird. The bird looked sad and did not fly. Tim thought, I can help! He walked over and saw the bird had a hurt wing. Tim was gentle and made a small nest with soft leaves. He put the bird in the nest and gave it water.   Day by day, Tim cared for the bird. The bird flew back, chirped, and said thank you. Tim knew he did something good!

Once there was a big dog named Bob. Bob loved to play and run. One day, he saw a boy named Tim. Tim was sad because he lost his red ball. Bob wanted to help Tim. He ran and looked for the ball. After a while, Bob found the ball under a bush! Tim was so happy. He said, “Thank you, Bob!” Now they were friends and played all day. Bob felt good because he helped Tim.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were three friends named Sam, Kim, and Tim. One day, they sat under a big tree and started to talk. “Did you see the new girl?” asked Sam. “Yes! It felt nice to share, but it was even nicer to be friends!

Once upon a time, a man named Tim had a big bag. In the bag, he had many fun toys. One day, Tim saw a girl named Mia. Mia looked sad because she had no toys to play with. Tim wanted to help. Once there were five friends: Sam, Ben, Mia, Lily, and Max. They loved to play outside. One sunny day, they ran and jumped in the big green grass. They were so happy! But oh no! They loved to play, even if they got messy. After a while, they all took a bath and felt clean again. Then, they went out to play some more!

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong man named Tyrannical. He liked to shout and be loud. The people in the town were scared of him. They did not want to play or laugh when he was around.  One day, a small girl named Mia said, Please stop! She was brave and did not feel scared. Tyrannical looked at her and saw her kind eyes. He thought, Maybe I can be nice. From that day on, he tried to be better. The people smiled, and they all played together.

Once upon a time, there was a big, green tree in a sunny park. A kind man saw that the tree was sad because it had no water. The man wanted to help, so he gave his own water to the tree. Once upon a time, there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A happy boy named Tim plays with his dog, Max. They run and jump in the green grass. Tim and Max find a red ball. Once upon a time, there was a big, happy dog named Max. Max loved to run and play with his best friend, a little boy named Sam. One day, they found a big ball in the park. Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a girl named Mia. Mia loved to play outside with her friends. One day, it started to rain hard. The sky was dark, and the wind blew. Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big red ball. One day, he wanted to play with his ball in the sun. He ran to the park and found a nice green spot. Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Tim. They wanted to play a game, but it was a tricky game. They sat on the grass and thought hard. Sam said, Let’s use our brains to win! Once upon a time, there was a big, tall tree. It had a trunk that was strong and wide. The tree's leaves were green and shiny. One day, a small boy came to play near the tree. Once upon a time, in a small town, there were two friends named Bob and Lily. They loved to play together every day. One sunny day, they saw a big, fluffy dog in the park. Once upon a time, there was a big group of friends. They wanted to play a game, but they needed to think first. Let’s sit and talk, said Mia. They shared ideas about what game to play. Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim saw a sad girl named Mia. Mia lost her toy in the park. Tim felt bad for Mia. He walked over and said, “I can help you!” Together, they looked for the toy. Once there was a girl named Mia. Mia had a little dog named Max. Mia loved to play, but sometimes she felt sad. She wanted to smile, but her heart felt heavy. Once, there was a girl named Mia. Mia felt sad and quiet. She wanted to laugh and play, but she did not feel like it. Her friends came to her and said, Come play with us! Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Bob. Bob loved to play with his friend, a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily had a fun idea. She said, Let’s play a game! You chase me, and I will run! Once there was a big group of kids. They all wanted to play a game. Some kids wanted to play tag, but others wanted to play hide and seek. They could not decide what to do. Once upon a time, there was a boy named Max. Max had a dog named Spot. Max loved to play with Spot, but sometimes he forgot to feed him. Spot would sit by his bowl and look sad. Once there was a man named Tim. Tim had a big red car. He loved to drive it fast and make it go vroom! One day, Tim saw a little cat stuck in a tree. The cat was scared and meowed. Once upon a time, a girl named Mia found a big red ball. She ran with it to the park. At the park, she saw her friend Sam. They kicked the ball and laughed. A dog came and wanted to play too. Mia and Sam took turns throwing the ball for the dog. They all had fun together.   At the end of the day, the sun began to set. Mia and Sam said goodbye to the dog. They waved and smiled. Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a group of friends. They liked to sit together and talk. One day, they saw a big dog in the park. Look at that dog! said Mia. He is so big and funny! Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Mia. They loved to talk and play together. One day, Sam found a big red ball. He said, Look, Mia! A ball! Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big red ball. He liked to play with his ball in the sun. One day, he saw a girl named Sue. Sue had a blue kite. Tim asked if he could play with her. Once there was a big bear named Benny. Benny loved to hug all his friends. He hugged the trees, the rocks, and even the flowers! But one day, he saw a little bird. The bird felt scared and said, Please don’t hug me too tight! Benny smiled and said, I will give you a soft hug.   So, Benny learned to give soft hugs. Now, all the animals felt happy and safe. They played and laughed together. Benny was a big bear, but he was a nice bear too!

Once there was a big, tall man named Ty. Ty loved to play with his friends. They ran and laughed in the sun. One day, they found a tall tree. Ty said, Let’s climb! They all tried to climb. Ty went up high. He saw the whole park! His friends cheered, Go, Ty, go!  But then, Ty slipped! Oh no! He fell but landed in soft grass. He was okay. His friends helped him up. They all hugged and said, You are brave, Ty! They played more games and had so much fun together. The end.

Once upon a time, in a bright and sunny land, there lived two friends named Tim and Pam. Tim had a big red ball, and Pam had a blue kite. One day, they wanted to play together. Tim said, “Let’s play ball!” Pam smiled and said, “Yes! Then we can fly my kite!”   They took turns and had lots of fun. When Tim threw the ball, Pam ran to catch it. When the wind blew, Pam let her kite soar high in the sky. They laughed and shared their toys, talking and playing happily. They knew that playing together was the best way to have fun!

Once upon a time, a man named Max had a big, red car. Max loved to drive his car to the park. One sunny day, he saw a little girl named Mia. Mia had a pet dog named Pip. Once there was a big, happy town. The people loved each other and always helped one another. One day, a big storm came. It was loud and scary. The people were afraid.   Then, a brave man saw that his friend was stuck in a tree. The man ran to help. He climbed the tree and brought his friend down safe. The man got wet and cold, but he smiled. He felt good inside because he helped his friend. Everyone in the town cheered for him. They knew that caring for each other was the best thing of all!

Once there was a big, happy family. They all loved each other a lot. One day, the dad felt sad because he lost his job. Once upon a time, there was a big, happy man named Tom. Tom loved to help little kids learn. He took them to the park and taught them how to swing. Mia felt brave! She had fun and made new friends. Tom was a good friend and a great teacher!

Once upon a time, there was a big man named Max. Max loved to help kids. He saw a little girl named Mia. Mia wanted to learn how to ride her bike. Max said, I can help you!   Max held the bike while Mia got on. Pedal fast! he said. Mia pedaled and laughed. She fell but got back up. Max smiled and said, You can do it! With a little help, Mia learned to ride all by herself. They both were so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a big, happy garden. In this garden, many flowers grew. There were red roses, yellow sunflowers, and blue daisies. A kind girl named Mia loved to take care of the flowers.   One day, Mia saw a little bug on a rose. The bug looked sad. Mia said, Don't worry, little bug! I will help you! She gently moved the bug to a nice leaf. The bug smiled and danced. Mia felt happy because she was a good friend to the bugs and flowers in her garden.

Once there were two kids, Sam and Kim. Sam liked to run fast, and Kim liked to jump high. One day, they played a game. Sam ran and ran, but Kim jumped and jumped. They wanted to win. They could play together! Sam could run while Kim jumped. They made a fun game and had big smiles. They learned that playing together was much more fun than being mad. Now, they are best friends!

Once there was a big, warm house. In the house, there was a kind mom and a sweet dad. They had a small dog named Max. Max loved to play and run.   One day, Max saw a bird in a tree. The bird looked sad. Max barked and wagged his tail. The mom and dad came out. They saw the sad bird too. They gave the bird some food and made it feel happy. Max was glad. They all smiled and played together in the warm sun.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Sam and Mia. Sam had a red ball, and Mia had a blue kite. They wanted to play together. Sam said, “Let’s play ball!” Mia smiled and said, “Yes! The wind blew, and the kite went up, up, up in the sky! They laughed and clapped. They used words to share, and their fun grew. Sam and Mia were happy because they talked and played together.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim had a big red balloon. He loved to play with it in the sun. One day, the wind blew hard, and the balloon flew up, up, up into the sky! Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia had a big, soft dog named Max. They played in the sun every day. They ran, jumped, and laughed together. One day, they found a big, red ball. Once upon a time, in a bright green park, there was a big, happy man named Gus. Gus loved to play with kids. He would run and jump, and they would laugh. They called its name, “Barky! Barky!” At last, they found Barky under a tree. Mia was so happy! Gus smiled and said, “Now we can all play together!” And they did, until the sun went down.

Once there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a pet dog named Max. One day, Sam wanted to play outside, but he forgot to take care of Max. Max was hungry and sad. Sam played and played, but then he saw Max looking at him with big eyes.   Sam felt bad. He ran to get some food for Max. He gave Max a nice treat and they played together in the sun. Sam learned to always take care of Max before having fun. They were happy together!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were three friends: Sam, Mia, and Tim. Once there was a big boy named Max. Max loved to run and jump, but he was very reckless. One day, he ran too fast and tripped over a rock. He fell down and got a scrape on his knee. Once upon a time, there was a small group of friends. They loved to play together in the big park. One sunny day, they found a lost puppy. The puppy looked scared and alone. They all worked together to find the puppy’s home. They asked people if they knew where he lived. Finally, they found his house! The puppy was so happy to be home, and the friends felt good for helping. They learned that being kind and working together is what makes them good leaders.

Once upon a time, a boy named Tim had a big red ball. Tim loved to play with his ball every day. One sunny day, he took the ball to the park. There he saw a girl named Mia. Mia had a blue kite. Once there was a kind little boy named Sam. Sam had a big heart and always helped his friends. One day, he saw a girl named Ella who looked sad. Sam walked up to her and asked, Why are you sad? Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim had a big red ball. Tim loved to play with his ball in the park. One sunny day, he kicked the ball high and it went over the fence! Once upon a time, a boy named Ben had a big red ball. He loved to play with it every day. One sunny day, Ben kicked the ball too hard, and it went up, up high into a tree. Once upon a time, there was a big, happy group of friends. They loved to play and help each other. When one friend fell down, the others were there to pick him up. Once there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A happy boy named Sam found a small puppy. The puppy wagged its tail and jumped around. Sam laughed and played with the puppy all day. Once upon a time, in a bright little town, there were two friends named Sam and Lily. Once there was a big cat named Leo. Leo lived in a sunny house with a small boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with Leo. They played ball in the yard and ran in the grass. Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam. Sam had a big red ball. He loved to play with his ball in the sun. One day, he found a puppy. The puppy was small and fluffy. Once upon a time, there was a big, tall man named Tim. Tim loved to play with his friends. One day, they found a big, red ball. They kicked it and ran after it. Inside, they saw the ball shining in the dark. Tim picked it up, and they all cheered! They were very happy and ran back outside to play in the warm sun. Tim smiled and said, Playing is fun!

Once there was a man named Tim. Tim loved to play with his pet cat, Max. One day, Tim found some fun toys in a box. There was a big ball, a red car, and a soft doll. Tim and Max played with the ball. Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. One day, a big storm came and blew away Tim's kite. Tim felt sad, but he did not give up. He pulled and pulled, and finally, it came free! Tim was so happy. He learned that even when things are hard, he can try again and be strong. Tim flew his kite high in the sky, and he smiled wide. Once upon a time, there was a big, bright sun in the sky. A little girl named Mia woke up and felt the warm rays on her face. She had a nice idea! “Let’s go play outside!” she said. Once upon a time, in a bright, sunny park, there were three friends: Sam, Mia, and Tim. Sam wanted to climb a big tree, but he was scared. Once there was a happy town. All the people were nice and helped each other. If one person fell, others would pick them up. If someone was sad, friends would hug them tight. Once there was a big group of kids who loved to play. They ran fast and jumped high. They were so happy! But they did not look where they were going. They bumped into each other and fell down. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to play in the sun. One day, a big storm came. The wind blew hard, and the rain fell. Once there was a big, green log in the park. Many kids came to play. They could sit on the log, or jump off it. One day, a little boy named Tim saw the log. He thought it looked like a big boat. Once upon a time, in a sunny town, there were three friends: Sam, Mia, and Tom. They loved to talk and share news. One day, Sam saw a big, red car. He ran to tell Mia and Tom. I saw a car!
