Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Sam. Sam loved to play with his big red ball. One sunny day, he saw his friend, Lily, crying in the park. Sam felt sad because he didn't like to see Lily upset. So, he went over to her and said, Don't cry, Lily. Do you want to play with my ball? Lily stopped crying and smiled. She nodded, and together they kicked the ball back and forth. Sam was happy because he helped his friend feel better. From that day on, Sam always tried to help his friends when they were sad. He learned that being kind made everyone happy.

Once, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy bear that he loved very much. But one day, Tim forgot to play with his bear. He left it on the shelf, all alone. The bear felt sad and dusty. It missed Tim's hugs and laughs. But Tim was busy with other toys and did not see the bear's sad eyes.  One day, Tim's mom saw the bear on the shelf. She picked it up and gave it a big hug. Oh, poor bear! she said. Tim saw his mom with the bear and remembered how much he loved it. He ran over and gave the bear a hug too. From then on, Tim played with his bear every day, and the bear was happy again.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim was playing in the park. He loved to dig in the sand with his red shovel. One sunny day, Tim saw a big, shiny ball rolling away. He really wanted the ball, so he ran fast, faster than he ever had before. As he reached the ball, he grabbed it and hugged it tight. But then, he saw a doggy barking nearby, wanting to play too. Tim smiled and gently rolled the ball to the doggy. They played together, laughing and running in the sun. Tim learned that sharing is fun, and he made a new furry friend that day.

Once upon a time, there was a big, red ball. The ball loved to bounce high in the sky. One day, Timmy and his friend Lucy found the ball in the park. They were so happy! They took the ball and played all day. They laughed and ran, having so much fun. But then, a big dog came. The dog wanted to play too. It chased the ball and bit it. POP! The ball was gone. Timmy and Lucy were sad. They hugged and said, It's okay, we can find a new ball. And they walked home, thinking about their fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a big, mean giant named Tim. Tim liked to take toys from kids and never shared. One day, a brave little girl named Anna decided to talk to Tim. She said, Please, Tim, can you share the toys? Tim looked at Anna and thought for a while. Then, he smiled and said, Okay, let's play together! From that day on, Tim was nice and played with all the kids. They laughed and had fun every day. Anna was happy because she helped Tim be kind and good.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a red ball that he loved to play with. One sunny day, Tim went to the park with his mom. At the park, he saw a girl named Lily. She had a yellow kite. Tim and Lily smiled at each other. Tim threw his ball, and Lily flew her kite. They played happily, running and laughing in the warm sun.  When it was time to go home, Tim waved goodbye to Lily. See you next time! he said. Lily waved back and smiled. Tim held his mom's hand and walked home with his red ball. He felt happy and thought about the fun day at the park. It was a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big red ball that she loved to play with every day. One sunny morning, Lily took her ball to the park. She saw her friend Max there, and they both started to play. They threw the ball high in the air and laughed as it bounced back down.   Suddenly, the ball rolled away and got stuck under a bush. Lily and Max looked at each other and thought hard. Let's use a stick to get the ball out, said Max. Lily nodded. Together, they found a long stick and carefully poked it under the bush. Slowly, they pushed the ball back out. Hooray! they cheered, hugging each other. They learned that thinking and working together helped them get their ball back. Then, they played until the sun went down. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big king named Tim. Tim was not very nice. He liked to take all the toys and candies for himself. All the kids in the town were sad because they could not play or have treats. One day, a brave little girl named Anna had a plan. She asked all her friends to share their toys and candies with Tim. When Tim saw how happy sharing made everyone, even him, he smiled for the first time. From then on, Tim learned to share, and everyone played together happily.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was very quiet and did not like to talk much. When he felt sad, he would hug his teddy bear tight. When he felt happy, he would smile a little, but he never laughed out loud. Tim's mom and dad wondered why he was so quiet, so they gave him lots of hugs and read him fun stories.  One day, Tim saw a colorful butterfly in the garden. It danced in the air, and Tim watched it with big eyes. Slowly, Tim felt something warm inside. He giggled, and it was like the sun came out from behind a cloud. From that day on, Tim knew it was okay to show how he felt, and he smiled a lot more, sharing his happy and sad with the world.

Once upon a time, there was a big, friendly dog named Max. Max loved to play with his little friend, Lily. Every day, Lily would say, Let's play, Max! and Max would wag his tail and bark with joy. They would run in the yard, throw a ball, and laugh a lot.   One day, Lily was sad. She sat on the grass and said, I feel bad. Max came close and licked her hand. Lily smiled and hugged Max. Thank you, Max. You make me happy, she said. Max wagged his tail again. They didn't need many words. Their hearts talked with love.

Once upon a time, in a big green park, there was a kind man named Sam. Sam wore a shiny hat and a big smile. Every day, he watched over the little kids as they played on the swings and slides. Sam was their friend and their guardian. He made sure they were safe and happy.  One sunny day, a small puppy ran into the park. The puppy looked lost and scared. The kids wanted to help, but they needed Sam. Sam came over and gently picked up the puppy. He found a tag on its collar with a name and number. Sam called the number, and soon the puppy's mom came to take it home. The kids cheered and clapped for Sam, their brave guardian who helped the puppy find its way back home.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to build tall towers with his blocks. One day, a big wind blew and knocked his tower down. Oh no! said Tim. But Tim did not cry. He smiled and said, I can build it again! So, he picked up his blocks and started to build a new tower. This time, it was even taller and stronger! Tim was happy because he never gave up.  His mom saw what he did and said, You are strong, Tim. You keep trying, no matter what! Tim felt proud. He knew that even if things fall down, he can always try again. And that made him feel like a big, strong boy! So, Tim kept playing, building, and smiling, because he knew he was strong and could do anything if he tried.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. Emma had a big smile and loved to play with her toys. One day, she saw her friend Max crying. Max had lost his favorite teddy bear and felt very sad. Emma sat next to Max and hugged him tight. She said, It's okay, Max. I will help you find your teddy. Together, they looked everywhere. Emma was very good at looking under things and behind chairs. At last, they found the teddy bear hiding under a big pillow! Max was happy again, and he and Emma played with the teddy all day. Emma felt happy, too, because she helped her friend. Emma learned that being kind and helping friends made her heart feel warm.

Once upon a time, there was a big, happy tree. Under the tree lived a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his red ball. One day, Tim saw a girl named Sue who wanted to play with the ball too. Tim said, Let’s play together! Sue smiled and said, Yes, please!  Tim and Sue took turns with the ball, and they laughed a lot. When Sue wanted to hold the ball longer, Tim kindly said, It’s my turn now. Sue nodded and gave the ball back to Tim. They played all afternoon, and when the sun was going down, they both said, Thank you for playing! Tim and Sue were happy because they shared and had fun together.

Once there was a big red ball. The ball was happy and loved to bounce. One sunny day, a little boy named Tim found the big red ball. Tim liked the ball and wanted to play. He kicked the ball high in the air. The ball flew up, up, up!  But then, the ball landed on a sharp rock. Pop! The ball went flat. Tim felt sad. He picked up the flat ball and said, Oh no! Tim tried to fix it, but the ball was too broken. He gave the ball a hug and said goodbye. Tim learned to be careful next time, and he hoped to find another ball to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big heart and loved to help his friends. One day, his friend Lucy lost her favorite teddy bear. Lucy was very sad and cried a lot. Tim saw Lucy's tears and felt a soft, warm feeling inside. He wanted to make Lucy smile again.  Tim looked everywhere for the teddy bear. He checked under the bed, in the toy box, and even in the garden. At last, he found the teddy bear hiding behind a tree. Tim ran back to Lucy, holding the teddy bear high. Lucy's face lit up with joy, and she gave Tim a big hug. Tim was happy because he made his friend happy again. And from then on, Tim always listened to his heart and made sure to be kind to everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to run and jump. One day, he saw a big, shiny puddle. Splash! he thought. Tim ran fast, but he did not see a rock. Oh no! Tim fell down with a big thud. He got up and said, Ouch! His knee hurt a little, but Tim smiled. He saw his friend Lily. Lily said, Be careful, Tim! Tim nodded and said, Okay! Then they both laughed and jumped over the puddle together, splashing water everywhere. It was a happy day.

Once upon a time, there was a kind mom and her little girl. The little girl had a yummy cookie, but she saw her mom was tired and sad. The girl thought, I love my mom! So, she broke the cookie in half and gave a piece to her mom. The mom smiled and hugged her girl tight. They both ate the cookie and felt happy. The little girl knew that sharing made her mom smile, and that made her heart warm. They sat together, feeling loved and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Sam. Sam had a big heart and could feel everything around him. When the sun was bright, he would laugh and play. When the rain came, he felt a little sad for the flowers. Sam loved to hug his teddy bear tight when he was sleepy. One day, he saw a bird with a hurt wing. His heart felt soft, and he told his mom. Together, they helped the bird feel better. Sam learned that being kind and gentle made the world smile with him.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big, big dog named Max. Max loved to run and play, but he didn't like to share. When kids came to the park with their toys, Max would grab them and run away. The kids would say, No, Max, that's not nice! But Max didn't listen. One day, a little girl named Lily brought her red ball to the park. Max saw the ball and wanted it. He ran to grab it, but Lily said, Please, Max, let's play together. Max stopped and thought. Then, he gave the ball back to Lily. They played together all day, and Max learned that sharing is fun. From then on, Max was a happy dog who loved to share and play with all his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big, red ball. The ball rolled down the hill, going faster and faster. Timmy and his friend Lily ran after the ball, giggling as they chased it. The ball bounced over a rock and landed in a puddle with a big splash. Timmy and Lily stopped and looked at each other, their clothes a little wet but their smiles bright.  Then, a little puppy came along. The puppy was very excited and barked at the ball. It wagged its tail and jumped around. Timmy and Lily laughed and threw the ball for the puppy. The puppy ran fast, catching the ball and bringing it back to them. They all played together, happy and full of fun, as the sun shined down on their happy day.

Once upon a time, in a big green park, there were two little kids named Tim and Lily. Tim had a bright red ball, and Lily had a blue kite. They loved to play together. One sunny day, Tim and Lily ran around the park, laughing and having fun. Tim kicked his red ball high up in the air, and Lily watched her blue kite dance in the wind. They took turns playing with the ball and the kite, sharing smiles and giggles.   As the sun began to set, they sat down on the soft grass, tired but happy. I like playing with you, said Tim. Me too, said Lily. They both looked up at the sky, where the sun was big and orange. It was time to go home, but they knew they would come back to play again. Tim and Lily waved goodbye, knowing they had made a special friend. And so, they went home, ready for more fun another day.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a kind girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her friends in the park. One day, while playing, she saw a little boy sitting alone and looking sad. Lily walked over to the boy and asked, Do you want to play with us? The boy nodded and smiled. Lily's friends joined them, and soon they were all laughing and having fun together. Lily felt happy because she knew being nice to others made their hearts feel warm. From that day on, the boy always played with them, and they all became good friends. Lily learned that being kind makes the world a better place.

Once upon a time, there was a kind man named Tim. Tim loved to help little kids learn new things. He would show them how to build tall towers with blocks and how to draw big, happy suns with bright yellow crayons. The kids loved Tim because he always had a big smile and made learning fun.  One day, a little boy named Ben was sad because he didn’t know how to tie his shoes. Tim sat with Ben and showed him step by step. One loop, then another, now pull tight, Tim said. Ben tried and tried, and soon he could tie his shoes all by himself. Ben was so happy and gave Tim a big hug. Tim was happy too because he loved to teach and help his little friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big red ball that he loved so much. One day, Tim saw his friend, Lily, sitting alone and looking sad. Her teddy bear was lost. Tim thought, I want to help Lily. So, he gave her his big red ball to make her happy. Lily smiled and hugged Tim. Tim felt warm inside, and they played with the ball together. Tim learned that being nice to friends makes everyone smile. And from that day, Tim and Lily were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big, quiet bear named Ben. Ben lived in the forest with lots of other animals. But Ben was different; he didn't like to show his feelings. When he was happy, he would just smile a little. When he was sad, he would sit under a tree and look at the sky. The other animals would laugh and play, but Ben liked to watch them from afar.  One day, a little bird named Bella flew down and sat next to Ben. Why don't you play with us, Ben? she asked. Ben shrugged and said, I don't know. Bella chirped, It's okay to feel happy or sad. We are here for you. Ben thought about it and smiled a big smile. Then, he joined the animals, and they all played together. Ben felt warm inside, like the sun was shining just for him.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. Emma loved her teddy bear so much. One day, her teddy got lost in the big park. Emma looked everywhere, behind trees and under benches, but she couldn't find her teddy. She felt very, very sad and started to cry. But then, a kind dog came with the teddy in its mouth. Emma was so happy! She hugged her teddy tight and said, Thank you, doggy! Emma learned to always keep her teddy close and never let go. And from that day on, Emma and her teddy were never apart again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars and blocks. One sunny day, Tim went to the park with his mom. At the park, he saw a big red slide and lots of swings. Tim was happy and ran to the slide. He climbed up and went whee! all the way down. After that, he and his mom sat under a big tree and ate a yummy snack. Tim smiled and said, I love the park!  While they were eating, a small bird flew down and sat near Tim. The bird chirped happily, and Tim giggled. He waved at the bird and said, Hello, birdie! The bird looked at Tim and hopped closer. Tim shared a tiny piece of his cracker with the bird. The bird pecked it and chirped again, as if to say thank you. Tim felt happy and loved the bird. It was a fun day at the park for Tim and his new bird friend.

Once upon a time, in a big green park, there were two kids named Lily and Gabe. Lily loved to look for bugs, and Gabe liked to play with his red ball. One sunny day, they found a little ant who looked lost. Let's help the ant find its home! said Lily. Gabe nodded and put the ball down. They followed the ant as it walked on the grass.   Lily and Gabe watched closely as the ant moved around. The ant found a tiny hill with lots of other ants. Look, it found its home! Gabe said with a big smile. Lily clapped her hands, happy that they helped the ant. The kids waved goodbye to the ant and went back to playing. They learned that being kind and helping others feels really good. And so, Lily and Gabe had a fun day in the park, full of smiles and happy hearts.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big heart and loved to help others. One day, he saw a tiny bird that had fallen from its nest. The bird looked sad and scared. Tim gently picked up the bird and said, Don't worry, little bird. I will help you. He found a soft, warm box and placed the bird inside. Tim gave it some water and bread crumbs to eat. Every day, Tim took care of the bird until it was strong enough to fly again. When the bird flew away, it chirped happily, and Tim waved goodbye with a big smile on his face. Tim felt happy inside because he was kind and caring.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a kind girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her friends. One day, they wanted to build a big sandcastle. Lily said, Let's work together! She showed her friends how to make towers and walls with sand. Her friends listened and followed her. They laughed and had so much fun working as a team.  In the end, the sandcastle was the biggest and best in the whole town. Everyone clapped and cheered. Lily felt happy because she helped her friends make something special. From that day on, Lily's friends always said, Lily is a great leader! And they all played happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big red ball. The ball liked to roll and bounce. It made kids laugh and play. One day, a little boy named Timmy saw the ball. Timmy said, Wow! He kicked the ball, and it flew high. But oh no! The ball landed in a big puddle. The ball got wet and muddy. Timmy tried to clean it, but it was still dirty. The ball couldn't bounce like before. Timmy felt sad. But then, Timmy's mom came with a towel and wiped the ball clean. Timmy smiled and said, Thank you, Mom! Now the ball was happy, and Timmy could play again.

Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a red ball. He loved his red ball and played with it every day. One day, Tim threw the ball too far. It went into the big, dark woods. Tim felt sad. He wanted his ball back, but he was too scared to go into the woods.  Tim's friend, Lily, saw he was sad. I will help you, she said. Lily held Tim's hand. Together, they walked into the woods. They saw the ball by a tree. Tim was happy and gave Lily a hug. But then, a big, scary sound came from the woods. Tim and Lily ran fast, holding the ball tight. They got home safe, but Tim learned to be careful next time.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his red ball. One sunny day, Tim took his ball to the park. He laughed and ran, throwing the ball high in the air. But oops! The ball bounced too far and fell into the pond. Tim tried to reach it, but it was too deep. He felt sad and sat by the pond. A kind duck saw Tim and pushed the ball back to him with its beak. Tim was happy again and said, Thank you, duck! They played together until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Ivy. Ivy loved to play in the big green park near her home. One sunny day, Ivy saw a shiny red ball rolling away. She ran after it, giggling and jumping. As she got closer, Ivy saw a tiny bunny looking at the ball with big, curious eyes.  Ivy stopped and smiled at the bunny. Do you want to play too? she asked. The bunny wiggled its nose and hopped around the ball. Ivy laughed and clapped her hands. Together, Ivy and the bunny played with the ball, rolling it back and forth. They had so much fun that day, and Ivy made a new fluffy friend. And every day after, Ivy and the bunny played in the park, happy and full of joy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to talk and sing. He had a friend named Sue. Sue liked to listen and laugh. One day, Tim said, Let's play! Sue smiled and said, Okay! They played with blocks and made a tall tower. When the tower fell, they both laughed and clapped.  Later, Tim saw a bird in the tree. He pointed and said, Look, a bird! Sue looked up and waved to the bird. The bird sang a pretty song. Tim and Sue clapped and danced. They were happy and felt close. They told each other, You are my best friend! And that made them both smile big smiles.

Once upon a time, there was a kind girl named Emma. Emma loved to play with her friends in the big, green park. One day, she saw her friend Timmy sitting all alone, looking sad. Emma walked over to Timmy and asked, What is wrong? Timmy said, I lost my toy car. Emma gave Timmy a big hug and said, Let's find it together!  Emma and Timmy searched high and low, under the trees and near the swings. Finally, they found the toy car hiding in the grass. Timmy smiled big and said, Thank you, Emma! Emma felt happy too, because helping her friend made her heart feel warm. From that day on, Emma and Timmy always helped each other, sharing lots of smiles and fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play in the big, green park. One sunny day, Tim saw a group of kids playing with a red ball. Tim wanted to join them, so he ran over with a big smile. But when he got there, one of the kids, Max, held the ball tight and said, No, it's mine!  Tim felt sad, but he thought of a plan. He picked up a stick and waved it in the air. Look, a magic wand! he said, making funny sounds. The other kids laughed and forgot about the ball. Max smiled and said, Can I play with the magic stick too? Tim nodded, and they all played together, laughing and having fun until the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there was a big family. They had a mom, a dad, a sister, and a brother. The sister liked to paint, and the brother liked to build with blocks. One day, the sister was sad because she couldn't paint a pretty picture. The brother saw her and said, I can help! He gave her a big hug and said, Keep trying, you can do it! The sister smiled and tried again. This time, her picture was very pretty.  The mom and dad came to see the picture. They clapped and said, Good job! The sister felt happy because her family was there to help her. The brother felt good too, knowing he helped his sister. They all hugged, and everyone was happy. The family loved to help each other, and that made their hearts feel warm.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play in the big green park. One day, Tim saw a cute puppy with a wagging tail. The puppy was lost and looked sad. Tim gently patted the puppy and gave it a biscuit from his pocket. The puppy wagged its tail even more and licked Tim's hand.   Tim looked around and saw a lady calling out, Buddy! Buddy! He knew the puppy must be Buddy. Tim and Buddy ran to the lady. She was so happy to see Buddy and gave Tim a big smile. Tim waved goodbye to Buddy and went home, feeling happy in his heart. The end.

Once, in a small town, there was a big, happy dog named Sam. Sam loved to play with the kids and was very friendly. One day, the kids wanted to play a game. Let's play follow the leader! said a little girl. Sam wagged his tail and barked with joy. The kids took turns being the leader, but Sam was the best at leading. He ran around the park, and all the kids followed him, laughing and clapping. Sam showed them how to be brave and have fun. Everyone said, Sam is the best leader! and they all had a wonderful day.

Once upon a time, in a happy little town, there was a big tree. Under the tree, lots of people would sit and talk. They would say, Did you hear about Tom? He got a new red bike! Or, Anna made yummy cookies today! Everyone liked to share fun news and stories.  One sunny day, a little bird flew by and listened. The bird liked the fun words and flew to tell its friends. Soon, all the birds were chirping, Tweet, tweet, Tom has a bike! Tweet, tweet, Anna's cookies! The people laughed and said, Even the birds like to share stories! And so, the tree was always full of happy talk, and the town was full of smiles.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were two friends named Tim and Mia. They loved to play in the park every day. One sunny day, Tim and Mia saw a big, fluffy dog. The dog had a shiny red ball. Tim whispered to Mia, “I think that dog can talk!” Mia giggled and said, “Let’s ask the dog!” But when they went to the dog, it just wagged its tail. The kids laughed and ran to tell their friends, “The dog has a magic ball!” Soon, all the kids in the park were talking about the magic ball. The dog just watched and wagged its tail, happy to have so many new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside. One day, it rained a lot, and the wind blew hard. All the toys in the yard flew away. Lily felt sad, but she did not give up. She put on her boots and raincoat and went outside. She picked up her toys one by one, even though the rain was still falling.   When the sun came out, Lily smiled. She had all her toys again, and they were clean from the rain. Her mom said, You are strong, Lily! Lily nodded and laughed. She knew she could do anything, even when things got hard. Lily was happy and ready to play again.

Once upon a time, there was a big, sunny park. In the park, there were kids and grown-ups. The kids liked to play with a red ball. They threw the ball to each other and laughed. One day, a little girl named Lily saw a boy named Tom sitting alone. Lily went to Tom and said, Do you want to play with us? Tom smiled and nodded. Lily gave him the ball, and they played together.   The grown-ups watched and talked to each other. They shared stories and laughed too. Everyone was happy. The park was full of talking and playing. At the end of the day, Lily and Tom waved goodbye. They knew they would play again soon. In the park, everyone was friends because they talked and shared.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. One sunny day, Tim saw a big, fluffy cloud shaped like a bunny in the sky. He pointed up and said, Look, Bunny! His mom smiled and said, Yes, Tim, it's a cloud bunny! Tim laughed and tried to hop like the bunny cloud. He jumped up and down, feeling happy and free.  As the sun began to set, Tim saw the sky turn pink and orange. Pretty colors! he shouted. His mom said, Yes, the sky is saying goodnight. Tim waved at the sky and said, Night, night, sky! Then, he held his mom's hand and walked home, ready for a cozy bedtime story. Tim felt warm and loved, knowing tomorrow would bring more fun clouds and colors.

Once upon a time, in a sunny park, there was a little girl named Anna. Anna loved to play on the swings. One day, her friend Sam wanted to swing too. Anna said, Let's take turns! Sam smiled and nodded. First, Anna swung up high, feeling the wind in her hair. Then it was Sam's turn, and he giggled as he flew through the air. They both felt happy because they shared and took turns. By talking nicely and sharing, Anna and Sam had a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big red ball that he loved to play with. One day, Tim was feeling sad but didn't know why. His mom saw him sitting quietly and asked, Tim, what's wrong? Tim just shrugged and held his ball tight. His mom gave him a hug and said, It's okay to feel sad sometimes. You can tell me how you feel. Tim smiled a little and whispered, I feel better now, Mommy. They played with the ball together, and Tim felt happy again.  From then on, Tim knew it was okay to talk about his feelings. He learned that sharing how he felt made his heart feel light. Tim and his mom would play and talk every day, and Tim was never afraid to say how he felt.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Benny. Benny loved honey so much that he would eat all the honey in the forest. The bees worked hard to make honey, but Benny would take it all. One day, the bees had a plan. They made a tiny honey jar just for Benny. Benny loved the gift and felt happy. From then on, Benny only took honey from his jar and left the rest for the bees. Now, Benny and the bees were happy friends, and they all shared the forest with smiles.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a big, friendly dog named Max. Max loved to play with the kids in the village. Every day, he would run and jump with them in the sun. Max was not just a dog; he was their guardian. He watched over the kids when they played outside, making sure they were safe and happy.  One day, a little boy named Timmy was playing by the pond. Timmy slipped and fell, but Max was there! He barked loud to call the grown-ups. They came running and helped Timmy. Everyone cheered for Max. From that day on, Max was known as the best friend and guardian of the village. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Max. Max lived in a green forest with lots of trees and flowers. Max was very quiet. He never laughed or cried; he just sat by the river every day. Max had many friends like Bunny, Fox, and Bird. They all played and laughed, but Max just watched. One day, Bunny asked Max, “Why don’t you play with us?” Max said, “I don’t know. ” Bunny gave Max a big hug and said, “It’s okay to feel happy or sad. We are here with you. ”  The next day, Max saw a rainbow in the sky. He smiled a little. Fox came running and said, “Wow, Max, you smiled!” Max felt warm inside. He realized it was nice to smile and have fun with friends. From then on, Max would laugh, play, and sometimes even cry. Max learned that showing feelings is good, and it made him happy to be with his friends. And so, Max the bear was never quiet again. He was happy, and his heart felt full.

Once upon a time, in a sunny park, there were two kids named Sam and Tina. They loved to play with their toy blocks. One day, they had a fun idea. Let's build a big tower! said Sam. Yes, let's do it! Tina cheered. They sat down and began to stack the blocks, one by one.  Sam and Tina talked about which blocks to use next. They picked the big, strong blocks for the bottom and saved the small, colorful ones for the top. This way, it won't fall down, Tina said with a smile. Slowly but surely, the tower grew tall and tall. When it was done, they clapped and laughed, happy with their big, bright tower. They learned that working together and thinking helped make their tower strong and tall.

Once upon a time, in a sunny park, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars. His friend, Jake, came to play too. Jake wanted Tim's shiny red car. Can I have it, please? Jake asked. Tim shook his head. Jake thought for a moment and said, If you give me the red car, I will share my yummy cookies with you. Tim loved cookies, so he gave Jake the car.  Later, Tim sat on the grass and thought about what happened. He felt a bit sad. He had his cookies, but he missed his red car. Tim learned that sometimes it's good to share, but it's also okay to keep things you love. The next day, Tim and Jake played again, but this time, they both shared their toys and had lots of fun together. They learned that sharing and playing nice made them both happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys, but he had so many that he didn't know which one to choose. He looked at his red car, his blue ball, and his yellow duck. Hmm, he said, scratching his head. I want to play with all of them! But he could only pick one.  Tim sat on the floor, thinking hard. His mom came over and said, Why not play with the car first, then the ball, and the duck last? Tim smiled and said, Yes, I will do that! So Tim zoomed the car, bounced the ball, and quacked with the duck. He was so happy he got to play with all his toys after all. The end.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim had a red ball. Tim loved his ball very much. One sunny day, he went to the park with his friend, Lily. They played with the ball, throwing it high in the sky. The ball bounced and rolled, and they laughed and ran after it.  As the sun began to set, Tim and Lily were tired but happy. They sat on the grass and watched the sky turn pink and orange. Tim held the ball close and said, I had fun today. Lily smiled and nodded. They both went home, dreaming of more fun days to come.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Ben. Ben was very bossy. He liked to tell all the little animals what to do. Go here! he would say. Do that! he would shout. The bunny, the squirrel, and the bird felt sad because Ben was too loud and bossy.  One sunny day, the little animals had a plan. They went to Ben and said, Please, Ben, be nice and play with us! Ben thought and thought. Then he smiled and said, Okay, let's play together! From then on, Ben was not bossy. He was a happy friend, and they all played in the forest every day.

Once upon a time, there was a big family that lived in a small house. The family had a mom, a dad, and two kids named Tim and Lily. Tim and Lily loved to talk and play with each other every day. They used words to say how they felt and what they wanted. When Tim was sad, he would say, I need a hug, and Lily would hug him tight. When Lily saw a pretty flower, she would say, Look, a flower! and they would smile together.  One day, it rained a lot, and they couldn't go outside. Tim and Lily felt bored, but Mom had an idea. She gave them some paper and crayons. You can draw and tell stories, she said. Tim drew a big sun, and Lily drew a happy dog. They showed each other their pictures and laughed. Even when they couldn't go out, they found fun by using their words and pictures. They learned that talking and sharing made them feel close and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big, friendly dog named Max. Max lived with a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved Max very much. Max was not just a dog; he was Timmy's best friend and guardian. When Timmy played in the yard, Max watched over him. If Timmy fell down, Max ran to him and licked his face to make him smile. Max always made sure Timmy was safe and happy.   One sunny day, Timmy was playing with his ball. The ball rolled away, and Timmy tried to get it. Max saw a busy road ahead and barked loudly. Timmy stopped and turned around. Max ran and stood in front of Timmy, keeping him safe from the cars. Timmy hugged Max and said, Thank you, Max! Together, they went back to play, happy and safe. Max was not just a dog; he was Timmy's guardian and best friend forever.

Once upon a time, there was a big red ball. The ball liked to bounce high in the sky. One day, a little boy named Tim saw the ball. Tim loved to play, so he ran to the ball and kicked it. The ball flew far, far away. Tim ran after it, laughing and clapping his hands.  But oh no! The ball bounced into a big, dark cave. Tim stopped and looked inside. It was too dark and scary. Tim felt sad and sat down. Just then, his mom came. She held his hand, and they walked home together. Tim felt happy again, but he missed the big red ball. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Tim. Tim loved his red ball. He played with it every day. One sunny day, Tim took his ball to the park. He kicked the ball high, and it rolled away. Tim ran after it, but the ball rolled faster and faster. Oh no! The ball fell into a big, muddy puddle. Tim's face was sad. He tried to reach for the ball, but he slipped and fell into the mud too. Covered in mud, Tim walked home slowly. He learned to be careful with his ball next time.

Once there was a little boy named Leo. Leo loved his toy blocks. Every day, he would stack them high, making tall towers. One day, Leo's friend, Gabby, came over to play. Gabby had a big idea. Let's build a castle! she said. So, they both worked hard, putting the blocks just right. They used the red blocks for the walls and the blue ones for the roof. Leo and Gabby laughed and clapped when the castle was done. It was the best castle ever! They were so happy and played with it all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big red ball. One sunny day, Lily took her ball to the park. She saw her friend, Tom, there. Tom had a blue kite. They played and ran around the park, laughing and having fun.   Then, the ball rolled away into a bush. Lily felt sad. But Tom had an idea! Together, they looked for the ball and found it under a tree. Lily and Tom were so happy! They played until the sun went down. They both smiled and said, What a fun day! It was a happy ending.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a red ball he loved very much. One sunny day, Tim took his ball to the park. He kicked it high and far, but oh no! The ball rolled into a big bush. Tim felt sad and worried. Just then, his friend Lily came by. I will help, she said with a smile. Together, they looked inside the bush.   After a short time, Tim and Lily found the red ball hiding under some leaves. Tim was so happy! He hugged Lily and said, Thank you! They played and laughed all day long. When it was time to go home, Tim waved goodbye to Lily, feeling very glad. It was a happy ending for Tim and his red ball.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. Emma had a big heart and loved her friends. One day, her friend Timmy fell and hurt his knee. Emma ran to Timmy and gave him a big hug. It's okay, Timmy, she said with a smile. Emma then gave him her favorite teddy bear. Timmy felt better and smiled back. They played together and laughed, and Emma felt happy because her friend was happy too. Emma learned that being kind and caring made everyone feel good inside.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Ben. Ben loved his little bear friend, Lily. One day, Lily fell and hurt her paw. She cried and cried. Ben felt very sad for her. He gave her a hug and said, It will be okay. Ben helped Lily by putting a soft bandage on her paw. Then, he found a yummy honey treat to make her smile. Lily felt better and gave Ben a big, warm hug. Ben was happy to care for his friend. They played together all day, feeling happy and loved.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play in the park with her red ball. One sunny day, she saw a boy named Max. Max had a blue kite that flew high in the sky. Lily and Max smiled at each other and decided to play together.  They ran and laughed, taking turns with the ball and kite. Max showed Lily how to fly the kite, and Lily taught Max how to bounce the ball. As the sun began to set, the sky turned a pretty pink. Lily and Max waved goodbye and promised to play again. They were happy to have a new friend. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Sam. Sam had a big heart and cared a lot for his friends. One day, while playing in the park, Sam saw a small bird with a hurt wing. He gently picked it up and said, Don't worry, little bird. I will help you. Sam took the bird home and gave it food and a cozy place to rest. Every day, he made sure the bird was okay and sang it sweet songs. Soon, the bird got better and flew up to the sky. Sam waved and smiled, feeling happy that he helped his tiny friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to talk with her friends at the playground. One day, she heard a funny story about a boy who wore his shoes on the wrong feet. Lily giggled and told her friend, Anna. Anna laughed and told her friend, Tom. Soon, everyone knew the story, and they all giggled together. Lily learned that sharing stories made everyone happy, but she also understood that it was important to be kind with words. So, she made sure to only share nice stories that made her friends smile.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with blocks and build tall towers. One day, he met an old man named Max. Max was very kind and knew how to build even bigger towers. Max showed Tim how to make strong towers that did not fall. Tim listened and watched carefully. Max and Tim laughed and had fun as they built together. Tim was happy to have a friend like Max who helped him learn. They became best friends and built the tallest tower in the town! The end.

Once upon a time, in a tiny town, there lived a kind mom and her little boy. One day, the boy wanted a big, red apple from the tree, but it was too high. The mom smiled and said, I will help you. She climbed the tree, even though it was hard and she was tired. She picked the apple and gave it to her boy. The boy was so happy and hugged his mom tight. The mom didn't get an apple for herself, but she was happy because her boy was happy. They laughed and played under the big tree, and the boy knew his mom loved him very much.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally loved to play in the garden. She liked to smell the flowers and watch the butterflies. One day, Sally saw a tiny bunny stuck in a bush. The bunny looked scared. Sally felt sad for the bunny. She gently moved the branches and helped the bunny get free. The bunny hopped away, happy and safe. Sally smiled, knowing she had helped a friend. From that day, Sally always looked out for her small friends in the garden. She learned that being kind made her heart feel warm and fuzzy.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved puzzles. One day, Tim found a big box full of toy blocks. He wanted to build a tall tower. First, he put the big blocks on the bottom. Then, he placed the small blocks on top. Tim thought hard and used his smart brain. Slowly, the tower grew tall and strong. Tim was so happy and clapped his hands. His friends came to see and cheered. Tim learned that thinking hard made things work well. And from then on, Tim always used his clever mind to solve puzzles.

Once upon a time, there was a big, friendly dog named Max. Max lived with a little girl named Lily. Lily loved Max very much. Max was not just a dog; he was Lily's special friend and her guardian. Every day, Max and Lily played in the garden. Max would run and jump, and Lily would laugh and clap her hands.  One day, Lily saw a butterfly. She wanted to catch it, but the butterfly flew far away. Max barked happily and ran after the butterfly, but he always stayed close to Lily. Max made sure Lily was safe, just like a big, gentle guardian. When the sun went down, Max and Lily went inside. Lily hugged Max and said, Thank you, Max. You are my best friend. Max wagged his tail and licked her cheek, happy to be with his little girl.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big red ball. He loved to play with his ball every day. One sunny day, Tim took his ball to the park. At the park, Tim met a girl named Lily. Lily had a yellow kite. Tim and Lily smiled and decided to play together. Tim kicked his ball to Lily, and Lily ran with her kite flying high in the sky.  Suddenly, the ball rolled away and went into a bush. Tim felt sad, but Lily said, Let's find it together! They looked and looked until they found the ball hiding under the leaves. Tim was so happy. He and Lily laughed and played all afternoon. As the sun went down, Tim and Lily waved goodbye, feeling happy because they had a new friend. It was a very happy ending.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were two little kids named Tim and Anna. They loved to play in the park every day. One sunny afternoon, while swinging on the swings, Tim whispered to Anna, “I heard a secret! Tommy has a new red toy car!” Anna's eyes got big with surprise. She giggled and said, “Let's tell Lucy and Max!” So, they ran over to their friends and shared the fun news. Soon, everyone in the park knew about Tommy's cool new car. Even Tommy joined the fun, showing off his shiny toy. The kids laughed and played together, sharing stories and secrets until the sun began to set. It was a happy day full of smiles and fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. Emma had a big heart and loved her teddy bear very much. One day, her friend Max came over to play. Max looked sad because his toy car was broken. Emma saw Max's sad face and felt it too. She walked over, gave Max a big hug, and said, It's okay, Max! We can play with my toys. Max smiled and felt happy again. Emma and Max played all day with her teddy and blocks, sharing laughs and fun. Emma knew that being kind and caring could make someone feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Rex. Rex loved to play with his ball. One day, a little boy named Max came to the park. Max saw Rex and wanted to play too. Max threw the ball, and Rex ran fast to get it. But Rex did not want to give the ball back. Max cried, Please, Rex, give me the ball! Rex barked and ran more with the ball. But then, Rex saw Max's sad face. Rex stopped. He walked back to Max and dropped the ball at his feet. Max smiled and said, Thank you, Rex! From then on, they played nice and had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. Lily had a big heart. One day, she saw her friend, Tim, who was sad. Tim had lost his toy car. Lily gave Tim a hug and said, It's okay, Tim. I will help you find it! They looked under the bed and behind the couch. At last, they found the toy car in the garden. Tim was happy again, and he thanked Lily with a big smile. Lily felt happy too, because she helped her friend. They played together all day, and their hearts were full of joy.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big dog named Max. Max loved to play with a red ball. Every day, the kids would throw the ball, and Max would run, run, run to get it. But one day, Max saw a cat. Max did not like cats, so he barked and chased it. The cat ran up a tree and looked down at Max. Max kept barking, but the cat just sat there safe.  The kids came and called Max back. Come, Max, they said. Max stopped barking and walked back to the kids. They gave him his red ball, and he wagged his tail. Max learned to play nice and not chase the cat. The cat came down, and they were friends. Now, Max and the cat play with the red ball together. Max is happy, and so is the cat.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. One day, his mom said, Tim, you have to help me with something very important. Tim was a little sad because he wanted to play, but he said, Okay, Mama.  Tim's mom needed help watering the flowers. Tim held the small watering can and poured water on each flower. The flowers smiled with their bright colors. After they were done, Tim's mom gave him a big hug and said, Thank you, Tim. You did a great job! Tim felt happy because he helped, and then he ran off to play. Helping was fun, too!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big, loud man named Tim. Tim was not very kind. He liked to take all the toys from the other kids. He would say, These are mine now! The kids were sad because they could not play with their toys. Tim made the kids do what he wanted, and they did not like it.   One day, a little girl named Lily thought of a plan. She said, Let’s all share our toys and have fun together! The kids liked Lily's idea. They all played and laughed, and soon Tim saw how happy they were. He felt left out and asked, Can I play too? Lily smiled and said, Yes, you can! But you must share. Tim learned to be nice, and everyone played happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Leo. Leo loved to play with his toy blocks. He would stack them up, one on top of the other, making a big tower. One day, as Leo was building his tower, he thought, I want to make it really, really tall! So he kept adding more blocks.  As Leo put the last block on, the tower wobbled and fell down with a crash! Leo was sad at first, but then he smiled. I know what to do! he said. He picked up the blocks and started again, this time making the bottom wider so the tower would not fall. Leo learned that when you build, you need a strong base. And with each try, his tower grew taller and taller!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his red ball. One day, he went to the park with his mom. The sun was bright, and the sky was blue. Tim threw his ball high in the air. But oh no! The ball went over the fence and bounced into a big puddle. Tim was sad because his ball was wet and muddy. His mom gave him a hug and said, It's okay, Tim. We can clean it up. Tim smiled and felt better. They went home, washed the ball, and played again.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to help her friends. One day, her friend Timmy fell and hurt his knee. Lily ran to him and said, Don't worry, Timmy, I am here. She gave him a big hug and helped him stand up. Then, Lily found a band-aid and put it on Timmy's knee. Timmy smiled and said, Thank you, Lily. Lily felt happy because she cared for her friend. From that day on, Lily and Timmy played together every day, sharing laughs and toys, always taking care of each other. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play in the park with his red ball. One sunny day, Tim saw a sad girl sitting on a bench. Her name was Lily, and she had lost her teddy bear. Tim wanted to help, so he said, Let's find him together! They looked under the slide, by the swings, and near the big tree. Finally, they saw the teddy bear hiding in the grass. Lily hugged her bear and smiled. Tim and Lily played with the red ball and laughed all day. It was a happy ending for both.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there were two friends, Tim and Mia. Tim and Mia liked to talk. They talked about the sun, the moon, and the stars. One day, they saw a big red ball in the park. Look at that ball! said Tim. I think it can fly! Mia giggled and said, No, silly, it can't fly, but let's play with it!  As they played, other kids came by. What are Tim and Mia doing? they asked. They have a magic flying ball! said one kid. Soon, everyone in the town was talking about the magic ball. Tim and Mia just laughed and said, It's not magic, but it is fun! And so, the kids learned that sometimes, stories grow bigger than they really are. But in the end, they all played and had a happy day.

Once there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to run and play. One day, he saw a big hill. I want to roll down! he said with a big smile. Tim ran up the hill, his feet moving fast. At the top, he looked down. Whee! he yelled, and he rolled and rolled. But oh no! Tim rolled too fast and bumped into a small tree. He laughed and said, Oops! His mom came and said, Be careful, Tim! Tim nodded, and they walked home hand in hand, ready for a big hug and a warm snack.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Ivy. Ivy loved to play in the big green park. One day, she found a shiny red ball and a fluffy teddy bear. Ivy wanted to play with both, but she did not know which one to pick. She scratched her head and looked at the ball, then looked at the bear. Her dog, Spot, wagged his tail and barked happily. Ivy giggled and said, Let’s play with both! So, Ivy threw the ball for Spot to chase and hugged the teddy bear tight. Ivy and Spot had fun all day, playing with the ball and cuddling the bear. It was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a big family who lived in a little house. They had a mom, a dad, a sister, a brother, and a baby. The sister loved to draw, and the brother loved to build tall towers with blocks. One day, the sister wanted to draw a big sun, but her crayons broke. She felt sad. The brother saw her and said, I will help you!  The brother gave her some of his blocks to hold the paper down. Mom and dad came over, too. Dad found some tape to fix the crayons, and mom gave a big hug. The baby giggled and clapped. With everyone helping, the sister made a big, bright sun. They all smiled and felt happy. The family knew that helping each other made them strong and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play in the park. She had a red ball and a teddy bear. One day, Lily saw a boy named Tom. Tom looked sad because he lost his blue car. Lily wanted to help. She smiled and said, Let's find your car!  Lily and Tom looked under the slide, by the swings, and near the big tree. At last, they found the blue car hiding in the sandbox. Tom was very happy. He said, Thank you, Lily! They played together with the ball and the car. They laughed and had fun. When it was time to go home, Lily and Tom waved and said, See you soon! It was a happy day.

Once upon a time, there was a big, red dog named Max. Max liked to run and play in the park. One sunny day, Max saw a group of kids playing with a ball. He ran over to join them, wagging his tail and barking happily. But Max was very, very excited and wanted the ball all to himself. He jumped up and grabbed the ball with his mouth.  The kids stopped and looked at Max. They were not happy because Max was not sharing. Max saw the sad faces and felt bad. He dropped the ball and gently pushed it back with his nose. The kids smiled and clapped. Max learned that sharing is fun, and they all played together happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there were three friends named Tim, Lily, and Max. They loved to play in the park every day. One sunny day, they saw a big, fluffy dog. Look at the big dog! said Tim. I think he can fly, said Lily. Max giggled and said, Dogs can't fly, silly!  As they sat on the grass, Tim whispered, I heard that the dog can talk! Lily's eyes grew wide. Really? she asked. Max shook his head and laughed. No, dogs can't talk! But then, the big dog barked, as if saying hello. The friends laughed and laughed, happy to play in the park with their new furry friend.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a big red ball. All the kids loved the big red ball. They would run, jump, and play with it every day. One sunny morning, the big red ball rolled away to a quiet spot near a big tree. The kids looked everywhere but could not find it.  Then, a friendly dog with a wagging tail found the ball. The dog barked happily and brought the ball back to the kids. They laughed and clapped, thanking the dog. The kids and the dog played with the big red ball until the sun went down. Everyone went home with smiles, ready to play again the next day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to run fast and jump high. One sunny day, he saw a big puddle in the yard. I want to splash! he shouted with a big smile. Timmy ran and jumped into the puddle. Water went everywhere, and Timmy got all wet and muddy. His mom came out and shook her head. Oh, Timmy, she said, you are so silly! Timmy giggled and said, I had fun! His mom laughed too and gave him a big hug. Then, they went inside to get dry and have some yummy snacks.

Once upon a time, there was a big, bright sun in the sky. Every day, the sun would wake up and shine its warm light on the little town below. In this town lived a kind girl named Mia. Mia loved to help her mom and dad. She would pick up her toys, feed her puppy, and put on her shoes all by herself. One day, Mia’s mom asked her to help water the plants. Mia said, Okay, Mommy! and ran to grab the watering can. She knew the plants needed water to grow big and strong.  Mia carefully poured water on each plant. The flowers smiled and seemed to say, Thank you, Mia! Her mom gave her a big hug and said, You are such a good helper! Mia felt happy inside. She knew it was important to help and take care of things. As the sun began to set, Mia waved goodbye to it, knowing she had done a good job. And the sun winked back, promising to return and shine again the next day.

Once there was a big man who liked to talk a lot. Every day, he would tell everyone what to do. Put your toys away, he said. Eat your veggies, he added. The kids at the park felt sad because they wanted to play and have fun.  One day, a little girl with bright eyes came up to the big man. She said, Please, can we play now? The big man looked around and saw the kids waiting. He thought for a moment and smiled. Okay, he said, Let's play! And from then on, the big man played too, and they all had fun together.

Once upon a time, in a sunny park, there was a little girl named Anna. Anna loved to play with her red ball. She threw it high up in the air, and it came back down with a bounce. One day, a big kid named Sam wanted to take her ball. Anna stood tall and said, No, it's my ball! Sam looked at her, then said, Okay, and smiled. They played together, sharing the ball, and had lots of fun in the sun. Anna learned that saying no was okay and that sharing could be fun, too!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Max. Max had a big red ball that he loved to play with every day. One sunny day, Max saw his friend Lily sitting alone and looking sad. Max went up to her and asked, Why are you sad, Lily? Lily said, I lost my doll, and I can't find her.  Max thought for a moment and said, Don’t worry, Lily. We can look for her together! They searched high and low, under the swings and behind the trees. At last, they found the doll hiding in the sandbox. Lily was so happy and gave Max a big hug. Max smiled and said, I'm glad we found her! They played with the doll and the red ball, and the day was filled with smiles and fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna. She loved to play with her red ball. One sunny day, Anna saw her friend Sam. Sam wanted to play with her ball too. Anna said, Let's take turns! Sam smiled and agreed. They tossed the ball back and forth, giggling and having fun.   Then, a big dog came running down the path. The dog wanted to play with the ball too! Anna said, No, doggie, this is our turn. The dog wagged its tail and watched. Anna and Sam kept playing, making sure both got a turn. They felt happy because they shared and spoke up. At the end of the day, Anna and Sam waved goodbye, knowing they had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his red ball. One day, the ball rolled down a big hill and got stuck in a bush. Tim felt sad, but he didn’t give up. He took a deep breath and walked down the hill. Step by step, Tim got closer to the bush. He reached out his hand and grabbed the ball. Tim was very happy and smiled big. He learned that trying again and again made him strong. Tim was a brave boy who never gave up!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big park. In the park, kids liked to play every day. One day, a kind boy named Leo saw his friends feeling sad because they didn’t know what game to play. Leo had an idea. He said, “Let’s play follow the leader!” All the kids smiled and cheered.  Leo led the way, skipping and hopping. His friends followed and laughed. They went around trees, jumped over tiny rocks, and sang fun songs. Everyone felt happy. At the end of the day, Leo’s friends said, “Thank you, Leo! You are a good leader. ” Leo smiled big and said, “I like playing with all of you!” And they all went home with happy hearts.

Once upon a time, there was a big, happy family. They loved to play and laugh every day. One day, the sky turned gray, and the rain began to fall. Everyone felt a little sad. But then, Mom had a fun idea. She said, Let's jump in the puddles! So, they all put on boots and ran outside. Splash! Splash! They jumped and laughed. The rain stopped, and a big, bright rainbow came out. The family hugged, feeling happy again, because they knew that even when skies are gray, fun and love are near.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his red ball. One sunny day, he went to the park with his mom. The grass was green, and the sky was blue. Tim kicked the ball and it rolled far away. A little girl named Sue saw the ball and picked it up. She smiled and gave the ball back to Tim. They both laughed and started to play together.   As the sun began to set, Tim's mom called him. Time to go home! she said. Tim waved goodbye to Sue. Bye, Sue! See you soon! he said. Sue waved back with a big smile. Tim and his mom walked home hand in hand. Tim was happy to have made a new friend. And the next day, he hoped to play with Sue again. The end.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big, happy family. The family had a mom, a dad, and three little kids. The kids loved to play with their toys and run in the sunny park. One day, the youngest kid, Lily, fell and hurt her knee. She cried and cried because it hurt a lot.  The big brother, Max, saw Lily crying and ran to her. He hugged her tight and said, It will be okay, Lily. I am here. Their sister, Mia, brought a band-aid and softly put it on Lily's knee. Mom and Dad came over and told Lily how brave she was.
